- **Lifecycle**: Singleton con dependencias inyectadas

| Metodo       | Descripcion                                      | Reglas de Negocio                                | Eventos Emitidos   | Transaccion | Complejidad |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------ | ----------- | ----------- |
| create()     | Crear nueva entidad con validacion completa      | Unicidad, campos obligatorios, reglas de dominio | created            | Si          | O(1)        |
| update()     | Actualizar entidad existente con optimistic lock | Version check, reglas de estado                  | updated            | Si          | O(1)        |

| clone()      | Clonar entidad existente                         | Reglas de clonacion                              | created            | Si          | O(1)        |
| bulkCreate() | Creacion masiva con validacion individual        | Reglas por entidad + limites bulk                | created (por item) | Si          | O(n)        |
| search()     | Busqueda full-text con scoring                   | Filtros de acceso RBAC                           | Ninguno            | No          | O(n log n)  |

- **Thread Model**: Stateless (connection pooling via Prisma)

| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------ | ------------ | ------- |

| findAll()    | findMany({ where, skip, take, orderBy })       | status + createdAt BTREE  | Si (TTL 2m)  | No           | 2       |
| save()       | create({ data })                               | PRIMARY KEY + unique name | Invalidacion | Si           | 3       |
| update()     | update({ where: { id }, data })                | PRIMARY KEY               | Invalidacion | Si           | 3       |
| softDelete() | update({ where: { id }, data: { deletedAt } }) | PRIMARY KEY               | Invalidacion | Si           | 3       |
| exists()     | count({ where })                               | UNIQUE constraint         | No           | No           | 2       |
| search()     | findMany({ where: { OR: [pg_trgm] } })         | GIN (trgm)                | Si (TTL 10m) | No           | 2       |

| export()  | POST   | /api/v1/search-&-discovery-module/export | ExportParams | FileResponse      | 400, 401, 500      | 5000ms       |

##### Search & Discovery ModuleService (Capa de Dominio)

- **Responsabilidad**: Contiene toda la logica de negocio del modulo. Orquesta operaciones, ejecuta reglas de negocio, emite eventos de dominio y coordina el acceso a datos.
- **Thread Model**: Stateless service (compartido entre requests, sin estado mutable interno)
- **Lifecycle**: Singleton con dependencias inyectadas
- **Dependencias**: ISearch&DiscoveryModuleRepository, EventPublisher, RulesEngine

| Metodo       | Descripcion                                      | Reglas de Negocio                                | Eventos Emitidos   | Transaccion | Complejidad |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------ | ----------- | ----------- |
| create()     | Crear nueva entidad con validacion completa      | Unicidad, campos obligatorios, reglas de dominio | created            | Si          | O(1)        |
| update()     | Actualizar entidad existente con optimistic lock | Version check, reglas de estado                  | updated            | Si          | O(1)        |
| delete()     | Soft delete con validacion de dependencias       | Sin dependencias activas                         | deleted            | Si          | O(n)        |
| validate()   | Validar entidad contra todas las reglas          | Reglas de dominio module-specific                | Ninguno            | No          | O(n)        |
| clone()      | Clonar entidad existente                         | Reglas de clonacion                              | created            | Si          | O(1)        |
| bulkCreate() | Creacion masiva con validacion individual        | Reglas por entidad + limites bulk                | created (por item) | Si          | O(n)        |
| search()     | Busqueda full-text con scoring                   | Filtros de acceso RBAC                           | Ninguno            | No          | O(n log n)  |

##### Search & Discovery ModuleRepository (Capa de Infraestructura)

- **Responsabilidad**: Capa de abstraccion de acceso a datos. Implementa el patron Repository y delega a Prisma ORM las operaciones de persistencia. Incluye logica de caching y query optimization.
- **Thread Model**: Stateless (connection pooling via Prisma)
- **Lifecycle**: Singleton
- **Dependencias**: PrismaClient, CacheManager, Logger

| Metodo       | Query Prisma                                   | Indices Usados            | Cache Hit?   | Transaccion? | Retries |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------ | ------------ | ------- |
| findById()   | findFirst({ where: { id, deletedAt: null } })  | PRIMARY KEY               | Si (TTL 5m)  | No           | 2       |
| findAll()    | findMany({ where, skip, take, orderBy })       | status + createdAt BTREE  | Si (TTL 2m)  | No           | 2       |
| save()       | create({ data })                               | PRIMARY KEY + unique name | Invalidacion | Si           | 3       |
| update()     | update({ where: { id }, data })                | PRIMARY KEY               | Invalidacion | Si           | 3       |
| softDelete() | update({ where: { id }, data: { deletedAt } }) | PRIMARY KEY               | Invalidacion | Si           | 3       |
| exists()     | count({ where })                               | UNIQUE constraint         | No           | No           | 2       |
| search()     | findMany({ where: { OR: [pg_trgm] } })         | GIN (trgm)                | Si (TTL 10m) | No           | 2       |

##### Search & Discovery ModuleEventHandler (Capa de Dominio)

- **Responsabilidad**: Reacciona a eventos de dominio del modulo y de otros modulos. Ejecuta efectos secundarios de forma asincrona como notificaciones, auditoria, sincronizacion y metricas.
- **Thread Model**: Async event processing (colas internas)
- **Lifecycle**: Singleton
- **Dependencias**: AuditLogger, NotificationService, MetricsService

| Evento Escuchado                       | Accion                             | Destino             | Async? | Retry? | Timeout |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------- | ------ | ------ | ------- |
| Search & Discovery ModuleCreated       | Registrar en auditoria             | AuditLogger         | Si     | 3x     | 5s      |
| Search & Discovery ModuleCreated       | Notificar a usuarios relevantes    | NotificationService | Si     | 3x     | 30s     |
| Search & Discovery ModuleUpdated       | Actualizar metricas del modulo     | MetricsService      | Si     | 1x     | 2s      |
| Search & Discovery ModuleUpdated       | Invalidar caches relacionados      | CacheManager        | Si     | 1x     | 1s      |
| Search & Discovery ModuleDeleted       | Registrar eliminacion en auditoria | AuditLogger         | Si     | 3x     | 5s      |
| Search & Discovery ModuleStatusChanged | Ejecutar workflow de transicion    | WorkflowEngine      | Si     | 5x     | 60s     |

##### Search & Discovery ModuleValidator (Capa de Aplicacion)

- **Responsabilidad**: Validacion de reglas de negocio especificas del modulo usando esquemas Zod. Se ejecuta antes de la persistencia y puede rechazar operaciones con mensajes de error descriptivos.
- **Thread Model**: Stateless (sin estado)
- **Lifecycle**: Singleton

```typescript
import { z } from "zod";

// Schema de creacion para Search & Discovery Module
export const createSearch&DiscoveryModuleSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, "Nombre es requerido").max(200, "Maximo 200 caracteres"),
  description: z.string().max(5000, "Maximo 5000 caracteres").optional(),
  projectId: z.string().cuid("ID de proyecto invalido"),
  config: z.record(z.unknown()).optional(),
  priority: z.number().int().min(-100).max(100).default(0),
  tags: z.array(z.string().alphanum().min(1).max(50)).default([]),
  metadata: z.record(z.unknown()).optional(),
});

// Schema de actualizacion para Search & Discovery Module
export const updateSearch&DiscoveryModuleSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1).max(200).optional(),
  description: z.string().max(5000).optional(),
  status: z.enum(["draft", "active", "paused", "archived"]).optional(),
  config: z.record(z.unknown()).optional(),
  priority: z.number().int().min(-100).max(100).optional(),
  tags: z.array(z.string().alphanum().min(1).max(50)).optional(),
  metadata: z.record(z.unknown()).optional(),
  version: z.number().int().min(1), // Optimistic lock required
});
```

# 7. Comunicacion entre Componentes

## 7.1 Protocolos de Comunicacion — Especificacion General

| Protocolo       | Version           | Uso                     | Seguridad     | Timeout            | Compression        | Circuit Breaker      |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ----------------------- | ------------- | ------------------ | ------------------ | -------------------- |
| HTTPS/REST      | HTTP/1.1 + HTTP/2 | Cliente -> API          | TLS 1.3       | 30s                | gzip, brotli       | 5 fallos -> open     |
| WebSocket       | RFC 6455          | Real-time (futuro)      | WSS (TLS 1.3) | No limit           | permessage-deflate | 3 fallos -> close    |
| In-Process      | N/A (TS calls)    | Capas internas          | N/A           | 5s                 | N/A                | N/A                  |
| PostgreSQL Wire | v3                | Repository -> DB        | SSL opcional  | 5s read, 10s write | N/A                | N/A                  |
| Redis Protocol  | RESP3             | Cache operations        | TLS opcional  | 100ms              | N/A                | 3 fallos -> fallback |
| gRPC (interno)  | HTTP/2            | Inter-servicio (futuro) | mTLS          | 10s                | gzip               | 10 fallos -> open    |

## 7.2 Matriz de Comunicacion por Modulo

## Comunicacion — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de comunicacion. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Especificacion de Comunicacion — Core Application Service

##### Flujos de Comunicacion — Core Application Service

| ID            | Origen                               | Destino                            | Protocolo         | Formato              | Patron             | Sync/Async | Latencia Esperada |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- | ----------------- | -------------------- | ------------------ | ---------- | ----------------- |
| MOD-01-COM-01 | Cliente Browser                      | Core Application ServiceController | HTTPS/REST        | JSON                 | Request-Response   | Sync       | < 200ms           |
| MOD-01-COM-02 | Core Application ServiceController   | Core Application ServiceService    | In-Process        | TypeScript objects   | Direct Invocation  | Sync       | < 1ms             |
| MOD-01-COM-03 | Core Application ServiceService      | Core Application ServiceRepository | In-Process        | TypeScript objects   | Repository Pattern | Sync       | < 50ms            |
| MOD-01-COM-04 | Core Application ServiceRepository   | PostgreSQL                         | TCP/PostgreSQL    | Binary protocol      | Client-Server      | Sync       | < 20ms            |
| MOD-01-COM-05 | Core Application ServiceService      | CacheManager                       | In-Process / TCP  | Binary               | Cache-Aside        | Sync       | < 5ms             |
| MOD-01-COM-06 | Core Application ServiceService      | EventPublisher                     | In-Process        | Event objects        | Observer           | Async      | < 1ms             |
| MOD-01-COM-07 | Core Application ServiceEventHandler | AuditLogger                        | In-Process        | AuditEntry objects   | Observer           | Async      | < 5ms             |
| MOD-01-COM-08 | Core Application ServiceEventHandler | NotificationService                | In-Process / HTTP | Notification objects | Observer + HTTP    | Async      | < 100ms           |
| MOD-01-COM-09 | Core Application ServiceController   | AuthMiddleware                     | In-Process        | JWT token            | Middleware Chain   | Sync       | < 5ms             |
| MOD-01-COM-10 | Core Application ServiceEventHandler | MetricsService                     | In-Process        | Metric objects       | Observer           | Async      | < 2ms             |

##### Especificacion de Protocolos — Core Application Service

| Protocolo      | Version  | Seguridad     | Timeout  | Pooling          | Compression        | Circuit Breaker      |
| -------------- | -------- | ------------- | -------- | ---------------- | ------------------ | -------------------- |
| HTTPS/REST     | 1.1, 2   | TLS 1.3       | 30s      | Keep-alive       | gzip, brotli       | 5 fallos -> open     |
| WebSocket      | RFC 6455 | WSS (TLS 1.3) | No limit | Persistente      | permessage-deflate | 3 fallos -> close    |
| gRPC (interno) | HTTP/2   | mTLS          | 10s      | HTTP/2 multiplex | gzip               | 10 fallos -> open    |
| Redis Protocol | RESP3    | TLS opcional  | 100ms    | Connection pool  | N/A                | 3 fallos -> fallback |
| PostgreSQL     | v3 wire  | SSL opcional  | 5s       | PgBouncer        | N/A                | N/A                  |
| AMQP (futuro)  | 0-9-1    | TLS           | No limit | Channel pooling  | N/A                | Configurable         |

##### Politicas de Retry y Resiliencia — Core Application Service

| Operacion         | Max Retries | Backoff Strategy              | Timeout | Circuit Breaker | Fallback                       |
| ----------------- | ----------- | ----------------------------- | ------- | --------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Read (findById)   | 2           | 100ms fixed                   | 5s      | No              | Cache stale data (TTL + 5m)    |
| Read (findAll)    | 2           | 100ms fixed                   | 5s      | No              | Cache stale data (TTL + 5m)    |
| Write (create)    | 3           | Exponential: 100ms, 500ms, 2s | 10s     | Si (5 fallos)   | Queue para async retry         |
| Write (update)    | 3           | Exponential: 100ms, 500ms, 2s | 10s     | Si (5 fallos)   | Queue para async retry         |
| External API call | 3           | Exponential: 1s, 5s, 15s      | 30s     | Si (3 fallos)   | Cache stale data (TTL + 30m)   |
| Event publishing  | 1           | 500ms fixed                   | 2s      | No              | Log event + manual replay      |
| Cache operation   | 0           | N/A                           | 100ms   | No              | Direct DB query (bypass cache) |
| Search operation  | 2           | 200ms fixed                   | 3s      | No              | Basic LIKE fallback            |

##### Formato de Mensajes Internos — Core Application Service

```typescript
// Evento de dominio: Core Application ServiceCreated
interface CoreApplicationServiceCreatedEvent {
  eventId: string;              // UUID v4 unico del evento
  eventType: "coreapplicationservice.created";
  timestamp: string;            // ISO 8601 UTC
  correlationId: string;        // X-Request-ID header
  aggregateId: string;          // ID de la entidad creada
  aggregateVersion: number;     // Version del aggregate
  actorId: string;              // ID del usuario que ejecuto
  actorRole: string;            // Rol del usuario
  payload: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    projectId: string;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  };
  metadata: {
    version: string;            // Version del schema del evento
    source: "coreapplicationservice";
    schema: string;             // URI del schema JSON
    traceId: string;            // Distributed trace ID
    spanId: string;             // Current span ID
  };
}

```

| Protocolo      | Version  | Seguridad     | Timeout  | Pooling          | Compression        | Circuit Breaker      |
| -------------- | -------- | ------------- | -------- | ---------------- | ------------------ | -------------------- |
| HTTPS/REST     | 1.1, 2   | TLS 1.3       | 30s      | Keep-alive       | gzip, brotli       | 5 fallos -> open     |
| WebSocket      | RFC 6455 | WSS (TLS 1.3) | No limit | Persistente      | permessage-deflate | 3 fallos -> close    |
| gRPC (interno) | HTTP/2   | mTLS          | 10s      | HTTP/2 multiplex | gzip               | 10 fallos -> open    |

| Operacion         | Max Retries | Backoff Strategy              | Timeout | Circuit Breaker | Fallback                       |
| ----------------- | ----------- | ----------------------------- | ------- | --------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Read (findById)   | 2           | 100ms fixed                   | 5s      | No              | Cache stale data (TTL + 5m)    |
| Read (findAll)    | 2           | 100ms fixed                   | 5s      | No              | Cache stale data (TTL + 5m)    |

| Write (update)    | 3           | Exponential: 100ms, 500ms, 2s | 10s     | Si (5 fallos)   | Queue para async retry         |

## 7.3 Pipeline de Middleware Global

```text
═══ PIPELINE DE MIDDLEWARE (orden de ejecucion) ═══

  [Request HTTP Entrante]
       │
       ▼
  ❶ CORS Middleware         → Validar origen, headers CORS
       │
       ▼
  ❷ Security Headers        → CSP, X-Frame-Options, HSTS
       │
       ▼
  ❸ Request ID              → Generar/propagar X-Request-ID
       │
       ▼
  ❹ Request Logger          → Log request metadata
       │
       ▼
  ❺ Body Parser             → Parse JSON, limit 4MB
       │
       ▼
  ❻ Rate Limiter            → Token bucket, 30/min default
       │
       ▼
  ❼ JWT Authentication     → Verificar token, extraer claims
       │
       ▼
  ❽ RBAC Authorization      → Verificar permisos por ruta
       │
       ▼
  ❾ Zod Validation         → Validar request body/params/query
       │
       ▼
  ❿ Route Handler           → Ejecutar logica del endpoint
       │
       ▼
  [Response HTTP Saliente]
       │
       ▼
  ⓫ Response Logger         → Log status, latency, errors
       │
       ▼
  ⓬ Compression            → gzip/brotli si aplica
       │
       ▼
  [Cliente]
```


# 8. Especificacion de APIs

## 8.1 Convenciones y Estandares de API

| Convencion         | Estandar                   | Ejemplo                         | Verificacion       |
| ------------------ | -------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| Base URL           | /api/v1/                   | /api/v1/user-modules/           | OpenAPI spec       |
| Versioning         | URL path                   | /api/v1/, /api/v2/              | Route registration |
| Content-Type       | application/json           | Content-Type: application/json  | Zod validation     |
| Auth Header        | Bearer JWT                 | Authorization: Bearer eyJ...    | Middleware check   |
| Request ID         | UUID propagado             | X-Request-ID: uuid              | Middleware         |
| Correlation ID     | Propagado en headers       | X-Correlation-ID: uuid          | Middleware         |
| Paginacion         | Offset + Limit             | ?page=1&limit=20                | Query params       |
| Ordenamiento       | Field + Direction          | ?sort=createdAt&order=desc      | Query params       |
| Filtrado           | Query params               | ?status=active&priority=5       | Query params       |
| Error Response     | RFC 7807 (Problem Details) | { type, title, status, detail } | Error handler      |
| Rate Limit Headers | X-RateLimit-*              | X-RateLimit-Limit: 100          | Middleware         |
| Compression        | gzip, brotli               | Accept-Encoding: gzip           | Response headers   |

## 8.2 Configuracion del API Gateway

## 8.3 Catalogo de Endpoints por Modulo

## Especificacion de APIs — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de especificacion de apis. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Endpoints del Modulo — Core Application Service

| Metodo | Endpoint                                      | Descripcion                                                                 | Autenticacion | Rate Limit | Version |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ---------- | ------- |
| GET    | /api/v1/core-application-service              | Listar registros de core application service (paginado, filtrado, ordenado) | Bearer        | 30 req/min | v1      |
| POST   | /api/v1/core-application-service              | Crear nuevo registro de core application service                            | Bearer+Owner  | 30 req/min | v1      |
| GET    | /api/v1/core-application-service/:id          | Obtener registro individual por ID                                          | Bearer        | 10 req/min | v1      |
| PUT    | /api/v1/core-application-service/:id          | Actualizar registro existente                                               | Bearer+Owner  | 10 req/min | v1      |
| DELETE | /api/v1/core-application-service/:id          | Soft delete de registro                                                     | Bearer+Owner  | 10 req/min | v1      |
| POST   | /api/v1/core-application-service/:id/validate | Validar contra reglas de negocio                                            | Bearer        | 5 req/min  | v1      |
| POST   | /api/v1/core-application-service/bulk         | Creacion masiva de registros                                                | Bearer+Admin  | 5 req/min  | v1      |
| GET    | /api/v1/core-application-service/:id/history  | Historial de cambios del registro                                           | Bearer        | 5 req/min  | v1      |
| GET    | /api/v1/core-application-service/search       | Busqueda full-text en core application service                              | Bearer        | 5 req/min  | v1      |
| POST   | /api/v1/core-application-service/export       | Exportar datos (CSV, JSON, PDF)                                             | Bearer        | 5 req/min  | v1      |
| GET    | /api/v1/core-application-service/:id/metrics  | Metricas de uso del registro                                                | Bearer+Owner  | 5 req/min  | v1      |
| POST   | /api/v1/core-application-service/:id/clone    | Clonar registro existente                                                   | Bearer+Owner  | 5 req/min  | v1      |

##### Configuracion del API Gateway — Core Application Service

```yaml
# API Gateway Configuration: Core Application Service
api_gateway:
  routes:
    - path: /api/v1/core-application-service/*
      methods: [GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH]
      strip_prefix: false
      service: CoreApplicationServiceService

  rate_limiting:
    enabled: true
    strategy: sliding_window
    window: 60s
    limits:
      default: 30 requests/min
      authenticated: 100 requests/min
      admin: 500 requests/min
    key_extractor: header(X-API-Key) | cookie(session)
    response_headers:
      X-RateLimit-Limit: true
      X-RateLimit-Remaining: true
      X-RateLimit-Reset: true

  authentication:
    enabled: true
    providers:
      - jwt:
          issuer: CoreApplicationService-auth
          audience: CoreApplicationService-api
          algorithms: [RS256]
          clock_skew: 30s
          claims_required:
            - sub
            - exp
            - iat
            - role
            - permissions

  cors:
    allowed_origins:
      - https://app.core-application-service.com
      - http://localhost:3000
    allowed_methods: [GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS]
    allowed_headers: [Content-Type, Authorization, X-Request-ID, X-Correlation-ID]
    exposed_headers: [X-Request-ID, X-RateLimit-*]
    max_age: 86400
    allow_credentials: true

  request_validation:
    max_body_size: 4MB
    max_header_size: 8KB
    max_query_params: 50
    content_types:
      - application/json
      - multipart/form-data

  response_compression:
    enabled: true
    algorithms: [gzip, brotli]
    min_size: 1KB
    level: 6

  logging:
    enabled: true
    format: json
    fields:
      - timestamp
      - request_id
      - method
      - path
      - status_code
      - latency_ms
      - user_agent
      - client_ip
      - user_id (if authenticated)
    sampling_rate: 1.0  # 100% for production

```

##### Formato de Respuestas — Core Application Service

```typescript
// Respuesta exitosa (200/201)
interface SuccessResponse<T> {
  success: true;
  data: T;
  meta?: {
    page: number;
    limit: number;
    total: number;
    totalPages: number;
  };
  timestamp: string;
  requestId: string;
}

// Respuesta de error (4xx/5xx)
interface ErrorResponse {
  success: false;
  error: {
    code: string;       // MOD-001, MOD-002
    message: string;    // Descripcion legible
    details?: Array<{
      field: string;    // Campo con error
      message: string;  // Mensaje especifico
      code: string;     // Codigo de validacion
    }>;
  };
  timestamp: string;
  requestId: string;
  documentationUrl?: string;
}

// Paginated response para Core Application Service
type CoreApplicationServiceListResponse = SuccessResponse<{
  items: CoreApplicationServiceEntity[];
```

##### Configuracion del API Gateway — Search & Discovery Module

```yaml
# API Gateway Configuration: Search & Discovery Module
api_gateway:
  routes:
    - path: /api/v1/search-&-discovery-module/*
      methods: [GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH]
      strip_prefix: false
      service: Search&DiscoveryModuleService

  rate_limiting:
    enabled: true
    strategy: sliding_window
    window: 60s
    limits:
      default: 30 requests/min
      authenticated: 100 requests/min
      admin: 500 requests/min
    key_extractor: header(X-API-Key) | cookie(session)
    response_headers:
      X-RateLimit-Limit: true
      X-RateLimit-Remaining: true
      X-RateLimit-Reset: true

  authentication:
    enabled: true
    providers:
      - jwt:
          issuer: Search&DiscoveryModule-auth
          audience: Search&DiscoveryModule-api
          algorithms: [RS256]
          clock_skew: 30s
          claims_required:
            - sub
            - exp
            - iat
            - role
            - permissions

  cors:
    allowed_origins:
      - https://app.search-&-discovery-module.com
      - http://localhost:3000
    allowed_methods: [GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS]
    allowed_headers: [Content-Type, Authorization, X-Request-ID, X-Correlation-ID]
    exposed_headers: [X-Request-ID, X-RateLimit-*]
    max_age: 86400
    allow_credentials: true

  request_validation:
    max_body_size: 4MB
    max_header_size: 8KB
    max_query_params: 50
    content_types:
      - application/json
      - multipart/form-data

  response_compression:
    enabled: true
    algorithms: [gzip, brotli]
    min_size: 1KB
    level: 6

  logging:
    enabled: true
    format: json
    fields:
      - timestamp
      - request_id
      - method
      - path
      - status_code
      - latency_ms
      - user_agent
      - client_ip
      - user_id (if authenticated)
    sampling_rate: 1.0  # 100% for production

```

```typescript
}

}>;
```

# 9. Flujo de Datos

## 9.1 Modelos de Datos por Modulo

## Modelos de Datos — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de modelos de datos. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Esquema de Datos — Core Application Service

| Campo       | Tipo         | Restricciones            | Descripcion                         | Indice  |
| ----------- | ------------ | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | ------- |
| id          | CUID         | PK, NOT NULL             | Identificador unico                 | PRIMARY |
| projectId   | CUID         | FK -> Project, NOT NULL  | Proyecto propietario                | BTREE   |
| name        | VARCHAR(200) | NOT NULL                 | Nombre descriptivo                  | -       |
| description | TEXT         | NULL                     | Descripcion detallada               | -       |
| status      | ENUM         | NOT NULL, DEFAULT active | active | inactive | archived        | BTREE   |
| data        | JSONB        | NULL                     | Metadatos flexibles                 | -       |
| config      | JSONB        | NULL                     | Configuracion especifica del modulo | -       |
| priority    | INTEGER      | DEFAULT 0                | Ordenamiento por prioridad          | -       |
| tags        | TEXT[]       | NULL                     | Tags de busqueda                    | -       |
| metadata    | JSONB        | NULL                     | Metadatos extendidos                | -       |
| createdBy   | CUID         | FK -> User               | Usuario creador                     | -       |
| updatedBy   | CUID         | FK -> User               | Ultimo modificador                  | -       |
| version     | INTEGER      | DEFAULT 1                | Version para optimistic locking     | -       |
| deletedAt   | DATETIME     | NULL                     | Timestamp de soft delete            | -       |
| createdAt   | DATETIME     | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW()  | Fecha de creacion                   | BTREE   |
| updatedAt   | DATETIME     | NOT NULL, AUTO UPDATE    | Ultima modificacion                 | -       |

```prisma
model CoreApplicationService {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  projectId   String
  name        String
  description String?
  status      String    @default("active")
  data        Json?
  config      Json?
  priority    Int       @default(0)
  tags        String[]
  metadata    Json?
  createdBy   String?
  updatedBy   String?
  version     Int       @default(1)
  deletedAt   DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
  @@map("coreapplicationservice")
}

```

##### Relaciones entre Entidades — Core Application Service

| Entidad Origen           | Relacion | Entidad Destino                 | Tipo                   | Cascade             | FK Constraint |
| ------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------- | ------------- |
| Core Application Service | N:1      | Project                         | Belongs To             | Restricte delete    | projectId FK  |
| Core Application Service | 1:N      | Core Application ServiceHistory | Has Many               | Cascade soft delete | entityId FK   |
| Core Application Service | N:M      | Tag                             | Through junction table | Restrict            | composite FK  |
| Core Application Service | N:1      | User (createdBy)                | Created By             | Set null            | createdBy FK  |
| Core Application Service | N:1      | User (updatedBy)                | Updated By             | Set null            | updatedBy FK  |

| config      | JSONB        | NULL                     | Configuracion especifica del modulo | -       |
| priority    | INTEGER      | DEFAULT 0                | Ordenamiento por prioridad          | -       |
| tags        | TEXT[]       | NULL                     | Tags de busqueda                    | -       |
| metadata    | JSONB        | NULL                     | Metadatos extendidos                | -       |
| createdBy   | CUID         | FK -> User               | Usuario creador                     | -       |
| updatedBy   | CUID         | FK -> User               | Ultimo modificador                  | -       |
| version     | INTEGER      | DEFAULT 1                | Version para optimistic locking     | -       |
| deletedAt   | DATETIME     | NULL                     | Timestamp de soft delete            | -       |
| createdAt   | DATETIME     | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW()  | Fecha de creacion                   | BTREE   |
| updatedAt   | DATETIME     | NOT NULL, AUTO UPDATE    | Ultima modificacion                 | -       |

```prisma
model Search&DiscoveryModule {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  projectId   String
  name        String
  description String?
  status      String    @default("active")
  data        Json?
  config      Json?
  priority    Int       @default(0)
  tags        String[]
  metadata    Json?
  createdBy   String?
  updatedBy   String?
  version     Int       @default(1)
  deletedAt   DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
  @@map("search&discoverymodule")
}

```

##### Relaciones entre Entidades — Search & Discovery Module

| Entidad Origen            | Relacion | Entidad Destino                  | Tipo                   | Cascade             | FK Constraint |

| Search & Discovery Module | 1:N      | Search & Discovery ModuleHistory | Has Many               | Cascade soft delete | entityId FK   |
| Search & Discovery Module | N:M      | Tag                              | Through junction table | Restrict            | composite FK  |
| Search & Discovery Module | N:1      | User (createdBy)                 | Created By             | Set null            | createdBy FK  |
| Search & Discovery Module | N:1      | User (updatedBy)                 | Updated By             | Set null            | updatedBy FK  |

##### Flujo de Manejo de Errores — Core Application Service

```text
═══ FLUJO DE MANEJO DE ERRORES: Core Application Service ═══

  [Request]
      │
      ├──❶── Validation Error (422)
      │        └─► ZodError → FormattedResponse → Client
      │
      ├──❷── Auth Error (401/403)
      │        └─► JWT Error → Security Log → 401/403 → Client
      │
      ├──❸── Rate Limit (429)
      │        └─► Rate Exceeded → 429 + Retry-After → Client
      │
      ├──❹── Not Found (404)
      │        └─► Entity Not Found → 404 → Client
      │
      ├──❺── Business Rule Violation (409)
      │        └─► Rule Error → Conflict Response → Client
      │
      ├──❻── Database Error (500)
      │        ├─► Retry (2x exponential backoff)
      │        ├─► Circuit Breaker Check
      │        └─► Fallback → Cache / Error Page
      │
      └──❼── Unexpected Error (500)
               ├─► Global Error Handler
               ├─► Structured Log (Sentry)
               ├─► Alert (PagerDuty)
               └─► Generic 500 → Client

```

##### Transformacion de Datos Paso a Paso — Core Application Service

| Paso | Capa         | Componente      | Formato Entrada     | Transformacion         | Formato Salida      | Validacion       |
| ---- | ------------ | --------------- | ------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------- | ---------------- |
| 1    | Presentacion | Formulario UI   | FormData/JSON       | Serializacion a JSON   | JSON string         | Client-side Zod  |
| 2    | Red          | HTTPS/TLS       | JSON string         | Compression (gzip)     | Compressed bytes    | TLS 1.3          |
| 3    | Aplicacion   | Body Parser     | Compressed bytes    | Decompression + Parse  | JSON object         | Size < 4MB       |
| 4    | Aplicacion   | Zod Validator   | JSON object         | Schema validation      | Validated DTO       | Zod schema       |
| 5    | Aplicacion   | Controller      | Validated DTO       | DTO -> Service params  | Domain params       | Type checking    |
| 6    | Dominio      | Service         | Domain params       | Business rules         | Entity object       | Business rules   |
| 7    | Dominio      | Event Publisher | Entity object       | Create event           | DomainEvent         | Event schema     |
| 8    | Infra        | Repository      | Entity object       | Entity -> Prisma data  | Prisma data         | Type mapping     |
| 9    | Infra        | Prisma ORM      | Prisma data         | Generate SQL           | SQL query           | Schema match     |
| 10   | BD           | PostgreSQL      | SQL query           | Execute + persist      | Result set          | Constraints      |
| 11   | Infra        | Repository      | Result set          | Row -> Entity          | Entity object       | Null check       |
| 12   | Aplicacion   | Controller      | Entity object       | Entity -> Response DTO | JSON response       | Serialization    |
| 13   | Red          | HTTPS/TLS       | JSON response       | Compression            | Compressed response | Content-Encoding |
| 14   | Presentacion | Cliente         | Compressed response | Decompression + Parse  | UI state            | Type checking    |

```text
      │
      ├──❻── Database Error (500)
      │        ├─► Retry (2x exponential backoff)
      │        ├─► Circuit Breaker Check
      │        └─► Fallback → Cache / Error Page
      │
      └──❼── Unexpected Error (500)
               ├─► Global Error Handler
               ├─► Structured Log (Sentry)
               ├─► Alert (PagerDuty)
               └─► Generic 500 → Client

```

## 9.3 Estrategias de Caching por Modulo

## Caching — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de caching. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Estrategia de Caching — Core Application Service

| Operacion  | Estrategia               | TTL    | Key Pattern                  | Invalidacion     | Tamanho Max |
| ---------- | ------------------------ | ------ | ---------------------------- | ---------------- | ----------- |
| findById   | Cache-aside              | 5 min  | MOD-01:entity:{id}           | On update/delete | 1 KB        |
| findAll    | Cache-aside + paginacion | 2 min  | MOD-01:list:{hash(filters)}  | On any write     | 50 KB       |
| search     | Write-through            | 10 min | MOD-01:search:{hash(query)}  | On index change  | 100 KB      |
| getMetrics | Write-behind             | 15 min | MOD-01:metrics:{id}:{period} | Periodic refresh | 10 KB       |
| getHistory | Cache-aside              | 30 min | MOD-01:history:{id}          | On new entry     | 50 KB       |
| exportData | Sin cache                | N/A    | N/A                          | N/A              | N/A         |

## 9.4 Estrategia de Migraciones de Base de Datos

| Aspecto            | Estrategia              | Herramienta                 | Rollback                | Verificacion               |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Migrations manager | Versioned migrations    | Prisma Migrate              | prisma migrate rollback | Schema diff                |
| Naming             | Timestamp_description   | 20250115120000_create_users | Down migration file     | File naming convention     |
| Data migrations    | Separate from schema    | Custom scripts              | Reverse script          | Row count validation       |
| Seed data          | Separate seed files     | prisma db seed              | Truncate + re-seed      | Data integrity check       |
| Production deploy  | Zero-downtime migration | Expand-contract pattern     | Contract migration      | Smoke tests post-migration |
| Backup             | Pre-migration snapshot  | pg_dump                     | pg_restore              | Snapshot comparison        |
| Branching          | Baseline + migration    | prisma migrate dev          | Database reset          | Schema alignment           |

## 9.5 Transacciones y Consistencia de Datos

| Operacion              | Transaccion?   | Aislamiento    | Duracion Max | Rollback?            | Deadlock Handling  |
| ---------------------- | -------------- | -------------- | ------------ | -------------------- | ------------------ |
| Create entity          | Si             | Read Committed | 5s           | Automatico           | Retry con backoff  |
| Update entity          | Si             | Read Committed | 5s           | Automatico           | Retry con backoff  |
| Delete entity          | Si (cascade)   | Read Committed | 10s          | Automatico           | Retry con backoff  |
| Bulk create            | Si (batch)     | Read Committed | 30s          | Automatico           | Reduce batch size  |
| Search                 | No             | N/A            | N/A          | N/A                  | N/A                |
| Export                 | No (snapshot)  | N/A            | N/A          | N/A                  | N/A                |
| Cross-module operation | Si (saga-like) | Read Committed | 30s          | Compensating actions | Retry + escalation |



# 10. Topologia de Despliegue

## 10.1 Vision General de la Topologia

La topologia de despliegue de **SW-AOE** define como los componentes del sistema se distribuyen fisicamente y logicamente a traves de multiples ambientes. La arquitectura sigue un modelo de despliegue progresivo desde desarrollo hasta produccion, con controles de calidad en cada etapa de transicion.

```text
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            TOPOLOGIA DE DESPLIEGUE: SW-AOE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                    CAPA DE RED / EDGE                          │
  │  [CDN: CloudFlare / Fastly]  [WAF: OWASP ModSecurity]          │
  │  [DNS: Route53 / Cloudflare]  [DDoS Protection]                │
  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                             │ HTTPS (TLS 1.3)
  ┌──────────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────────────┐
  │               LOAD BALANCER / REVERSE PROXY                    │
  │  [Caddy / Nginx]  TLS Termination, Rate Limiting, Routing      │
  └────────┬─────────────────┬──────────────────┬───────────────────┘
           │                 │                  │
  ┌────────▼──────┐ ┌───────▼────────┐ ┌──────▼────────────┐
  │  App Server 1 │ │ App Server 2   │ │ App Server N      │
  │  Next.js 16   │ │ Next.js 16     │ │ Next.js 16        │
  │  PM2 Cluster  │ │ PM2 Cluster    │ │ PM2 Cluster       │
  │  4 workers    │ │ 4 workers      │ │ 4 workers         │
  └────────┬──────┘ └───────┬────────┘ └──────┬────────────┘
           │                │                  │
  ┌────────▼────────────────▼──────────────────▼──────────────────┐
  │                    CAPA DE DATOS                              │
  │  [PostgreSQL 16 HA]  [Redis Cache]  [Object Storage S3]       │
  │  [Streaming Replication]  [Sentinel]  [MinIO / R2]             │
  └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
           │
  ┌────────▼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                  CAPA DE OBSERVABILIDAD                       │
  │  [Prometheus]  [Grafana]  [Loki]  [Tempo]  [AlertManager]     │
  └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 10.2 Arquitectura de Red

| Capa          | Componente    | Tecnologia                       | Configuracion                      | Proposito                          | Seguridad           |
| ------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| Edge          | CDN           | CloudFlare Enterprise / Fastly   | Cache TTL 1h, Bypass stale         | Distribucion de contenido estatico | DDoS L3/L4/L7       |
| Edge          | DNS           | Route53 / Cloudflare DNS         | TTL 300s, GeoDNS                   | Resolucion de nombres              | DNSSEC enabled      |
| Edge          | WAF           | CloudFlare WAF / ModSecurity     | OWASP Core Rule Set                | Proteccion L7                      | SQLi, XSS, RFI      |
| Perimetro     | Firewall      | iptables / UFW / Security Groups | Allow 443, 80, 22 only             | Filtrado de paquetes               | Stateful inspection |
| Balanceo      | Load Balancer | Caddy 2.x / Nginx                | Round-robin + health check         | Distribucion de trafico            | TLS termination     |
| Aplicacion    | App Servers   | VPS / EC2 / Droplets             | 2-10 instancias, PM2 cluster       | Ejecucion de aplicacion            | Network isolation   |
| Datos         | Database      | PostgreSQL 16                    | Primary + Replicas                 | Persistencia ACID                  | Encryption at rest  |
| Cache         | Redis         | Redis 7.x / Sentinel             | Cluster mode, 3+ nodos             | Caching distribuido                | AUTH + TLS          |
| Storage       | Object Store  | MinIO / AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2   | Versioning, lifecycle policies     | Almacenamiento de archivos         | Presigned URLs      |
| Monitoreo     | Prometheus    | Prometheus 2.x + AlertManager    | 15s scrape interval, 15d retention | Recopilacion de metricas           | mTLS internal       |
| Visualizacion | Grafana       | Grafana 10.x + Loki + Tempo      | SSO, RBAC, audit logging           | Dashboards y alertas               | VPN access only     |

## 10.3 Ambientes de Despliegue

| Ambiente             | Proposito                               | Infraestructura                | Datos                            | Acceso             | Despliegue            |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------------- | ------------------ | --------------------- |
| Desarrollo (Dev)     | Desarrollo local y pruebas individuales | Docker Compose / Local         | SQLite local + seeds             | Solo desarrollador | Manual (git push)     |
| Integracion (CI)     | Validacion automatizada en pipeline     | GitHub Actions runner          | PostgreSQL ephemeral             | Solo CI/CD         | Automatico en cada PR |
| Staging (QA)         | Pruebas de integracion y QA             | 1x App Server, 1x DB           | Datos anonimizados de produccion | Equipo de QA + Dev | Auto en merge a main  |
| Pre-produccion (UAT) | Validacion final con stakeholders       | Misma topologia que produccion | Subset de produccion (10%)       | Stakeholders + PM  | Manual con aprobacion |
| Produccion           | Servicio a usuarios finales             | Multi-instancia, HA completo   | Datos reales                     | Solo DevOps + SRE  | Blue-green / canary   |
| Disaster Recovery    | Recuperacion ante desastres             | Replica pasiva en otra region  | Streaming replication            | Solo emergencias   | Failover automatico   |

| Disco           | 20 GB                | 14 GB SSD              | 100 GB SSD          | 200 GB SSD              | 500+ GB SSD (RAID)            |
| Base de Datos   | SQLite               | PostgreSQL ephemeral   | PostgreSQL 16       | PostgreSQL 16 + Replica | PostgreSQL 16 HA + 3 Replicas |
| Redis           | In-memory (LRU)      | N/A                    | Redis single        | Redis Sentinel          | Redis Cluster 3 nodos         |

| Connection Pool | 5                    | N/A                    | 15                  | 30                      | 50-100                        |

## 10.5 Estrategia de Despliegue

### 10.5.1 Blue-Green Deployment

El sistema utiliza una estrategia de despliegue blue-green para minimizar el downtime y permitir rollback inmediato. La infraestructura mantiene dos entornos identicos (blue y green), y el trafico se redirige de forma atomica mediante el load balancer.

```text
  DESPLIEGUE BLUE-GREEN

  1. Build: npm run build -> generacion de .next/
  2. Pre-deploy: Health check en ambiente verde
  3. Smoke tests: Verificar endpoints criticos
  4. Switch: Cambiar upstream del load balancer a verde
  5. Validate: Monitorear metricas durante 5 min
  6. Finalize: Si OK, verde es el nuevo activo
  7. Rollback: Si problemas, revertir a azul en < 30s
```

### 10.5.2 Canary Release

| Fase         | Porcentaje de Trafico | Duracion   | Criterio de Promocion                   | Criterio de Rollback | Accion        |
| ------------ | --------------------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------- | -------------------- | ------------- |
| Canary 1%    | 1%                    | 5 minutos  | Error rate < 0.1%, latencia p95 < 300ms | Error rate > 1%      | Revertir 100% |
| Canary 5%    | 5%                    | 15 minutos | Error rate < 0.1%, latencia p95 < 250ms | Error rate > 0.5%    | Revertir 100% |
| Canary 25%   | 25%                   | 30 minutos | Error rate < 0.1%, latencia p95 < 200ms | Error rate > 0.5%    | Revertir 100% |
| Full Rollout | 100%                  | Permanente | Estable por 30 min                      | N/A                  | N/A           |

## Topologia de Despliegue — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de topologia de despliegue. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Despliegue Especifico del Modulo MOD-01: Core Application Service

El modulo Core Application Service se despliega como parte integrada del monolito, pero tiene configuraciones de infraestructura especificas que se detallan a continuacion.

##### Recursos de Infraestructura — Core Application Service

## 10.10 Procedimiento de Despliegue Paso a Paso

01. Merge de branch a main en el repositorio de codigo fuente
02. CI pipeline: lint (ESLint) + type-check (tsc) + unit tests (Vitest)
03. CI pipeline: build de produccion (next build) + bundle analysis
04. CI pipeline: integration tests contra staging ephemeral
05. CI pipeline: E2E tests (Playwright) contra staging
06. CD pipeline: Docker image build + push to registry
07. CD pipeline: despliegue blue-green en produccion
08. CD pipeline: smoke tests (endpoints criticos responden 200)
09. CD pipeline: switch de trafico al nuevo entorno verde
10. CD pipeline: monitoreo durante 5 minutos, rollback automatico si error rate > 1%
11. Post-deploy: notificacion a Slack con resultado del despliegue
12. Post-deploy: actualizacion de dashboards de monitoreo



# 11. Escalabilidad

## 11.1 Estrategia General de Escalabilidad

```text
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            MATRIZ DE ESCALABILIDAD DEL SISTEMA
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Dimension          Actual        Objetivo      Estrategia
  ─────────────────  ────────────  ────────────  ──────────────────────
  CPU                2 vCPU        16 vCPU        Vertical + Horizontal
  RAM                4 GB          64 GB          Vertical
  Instancias App     1             10             Horizontal (auto-scale)
  Conexiones BD      20            200            Connection pooling
  Read Replicas      0             3              Streaming replication
  Cache              In-memory     Redis Cluster  Distribuido
  Almacenamiento     100 GB SSD    5 TB           Object storage
  Workers            4             40             PM2 cluster scaling
  Throughput API     100 req/s     5000 req/s     Load balancing
  Usuarios           100           10,000         Auto-scaling dinamico
  Registros/seg      10            1000           Partitioned logging
  Colas activas      1             20             Worker pool expansion
```

La estrategia de escalabilidad de SW-AOE sigue un enfoque progresivo que permite crecer desde un despliegue de instancia unica hasta una arquitectura distribuida multi-region, manteniendo compatibilidad con las restricciones presupuestarias y de equipo actuales.

## 11.2 Dimensiones de Escalabilidad

| Dimension             | Escala Actual (MVP) | Escala Objetivo (V2) | Escala Enterprise   | Estrategia               | Trigger de Escalado        |
| --------------------- | ------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------ | -------------------------- |
| Computo (CPU)         | 2 vCPU              | 8 vCPU               | 64+ vCPU            | Vertical + Horizontal    | CPU > 70% por 5 min        |
| Memoria (RAM)         | 4 GB                | 16 GB                | 128+ GB             | Vertical                 | RAM > 80% por 3 min        |
| Instancias App        | 1                   | 3-5                  | 10-50               | Horizontal auto-scale    | Req/s > 80% capacidad      |
| Usuarios concurrentes | 100                 | 1,000                | 50,000+             | Horizontal               | Active sessions > 80% pool |
| Requests/segundo      | 100 req/s           | 1,000 req/s          | 10,000 req/s        | Load balancing + caching | p95 latency > budget       |
| Throughput BD         | 100 qps             | 1,000 qps            | 10,000 qps          | Read replicas + sharding | DB CPU > 70%               |
| Almacenamiento        | 100 GB              | 1 TB                 | 10+ TB              | Object storage           | Disk usage > 80%           |
| Cache                 | In-memory 100MB     | Redis 4 GB           | Redis Cluster 32 GB | Redis cluster            | Hit rate < 80%             |
| Conexiones BD         | 20                  | 100                  | 500                 | Connection pooling       | Pool utilization > 80%     |
| Background jobs       | 1 worker            | 5 workers            | 50 workers          | Worker pool              | Queue depth > 1000         |
| Datos totales         | 1M registros        | 50M registros        | 1B+ registros       | Partitioning + archiving | Query time > SLA           |

## 11.3 Escalado Horizontal

| Componente    | Metodo de Escalado    | Configuracion Min | Configuracion Max      | Cooldown             | Metricas               |
| ------------- | --------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------- | -------------------- | ---------------------- |
| App Servers   | PM2 cluster + Docker  | 1 instancia       | 10 instancias          | 5 min up, 3 min down | CPU, Memory, Req/s     |
| API Workers   | Auto-scaling group    | 1 worker          | 20 workers             | 2 min up, 1 min down | Queue depth, CPU       |
| Read Replicas | Streaming replication | 0 replicas        | 5 replicas             | Manual promotion     | Read qps, Lag bytes    |
| Redis Cluster | Redis Cluster mode    | 1 master          | 6 masters + 6 replicas | Manual               | Memory, Ops/s          |
| CDN Edge      | Cloudflare / Fastly   | 1 region          | Global (200+ PoPs)     | Automatic            | Latency p95, Bandwidth |

## 11.4 Escalado Vertical

| Recurso        | Nivel 1 (MVP) | Nivel 2 (Crecimiento) | Nivel 3 (Enterprise) | Costo Estimado         | Justificacion                      |
| -------------- | ------------- | --------------------- | -------------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| CPU            | 2 vCPU        | 4 vCPU                | 16-32 vCPU           | $20 -> $80 -> $500/mes | Procesamiento de logica de negocio |
| RAM            | 4 GB          | 8 GB                  | 32-128 GB            | $10 -> $40 -> $300/mes | Caché + conexiones + procesos      |
| Disco          | 50 GB SSD     | 200 GB SSD            | 2 TB NVMe            | $5 -> $20 -> $200/mes  | Datos + logs + backups             |
| IOPS           | 500 IOPS      | 3,000 IOPS            | 20,000 IOPS          | Incluido               | Operaciones de BD                  |
| Ancho de banda | 100 Mbps      | 1 Gbps                | 10 Gbps              | $10 -> $50 -> $300/mes | Trafico de API + exports           |

## 11.5 Estrategias de Caching

| Nivel            | Tecnologia              | TTL             | Invalidacion         | Casos de Uso                                  | Hit Rate Objetivo |
| ---------------- | ----------------------- | --------------- | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| L1 - Browser     | HTTP Cache Headers      | 1 hora          | ETag + Cache-Control | Assets estaticos, paginas raramente cambiadas | 80%               |
| L2 - CDN         | CloudFlare cache        | 1 hora          | Purge API            | Assets publicos, imagenes, fonts              | 95%               |
| L3 - Application | In-memory LRU (Node.js) | 5 minutos       | TTL + LRU eviction   | Datos de configuracion, sesiones activas      | 90%               |
| L4 - Redis       | Redis Cluster           | 1 hora          | Write-through + TTL  | Queries frecuentes, sesiones distribuidas     | 95%               |
| L5 - Database    | PostgreSQL query cache  | N/A (automatic) | Query invalidation   | Queries repetitivos costosas                  | Variable          |

## 11.6 Configuracion de Auto-Scaling

```yaml
# Auto-scaling configuration
autoscaling:
  app_servers:
    min_instances: 1
    max_instances: 10
    scale_up:
      cpu_threshold: 70
      memory_threshold: 80
      requests_per_second: 500
      cooldown: 300  # 5 minutos
    scale_down:
      cpu_threshold: 30
      memory_threshold: 50
      requests_per_second: 100
      cooldown: 180  # 3 minutos
  database:
    read_replicas:
      min: 0
      max: 5
      trigger:
        read_qps: 500
        replication_lag_bytes: 10485760  # 10MB
  cache:
    redis_cluster:
      min_masters: 1
      max_masters: 6
      memory_threshold: 80

```

## 11.7 Estrategia de Particion de Datos

| Estrategia              | Aplicable a           | Clave de Particion     | Ventaja                  | Desventaja                 | Cuando Aplicar              |
| ----------------------- | --------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------ | -------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| Vertical Partitioning   | Tablas grandes        | Por modulo de dominio  | Simplicidad, aislamiento | Cross-table queries lentas | > 10M registros por tabla   |
| Horizontal Sharding     | Datos de alto volumen | tenant_id o project_id | Escalado lineal          | Complexidad de routing     | > 100M registros            |
| Time-based Partitioning | Datos temporales      | Rango de fecha         | Archivado eficiente      | Queries cross-partition    | Logs, auditoria, metricas   |
| List Partitioning       | Datos categoricos     | status o region        | Queries optimizadas      | Distribucion desigual      | Datos con categorias claras |

## 11.8 Limites del Sistema y Degradacion Graceful

| Recurso       | Limite Normal   | Limite Warning | Limite Critico | Accion Warning              | Accion Critica                   |
| ------------- | --------------- | -------------- | -------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| CPU           | < 50%           | 50-80%         | > 80%          | Preparar nuevo nodo         | Scale-up inmediato + alerta      |
| RAM           | < 60%           | 60-85%         | > 85%          | GC agresivo + limpiar cache | Restart proceso + alerta critica |
| Disco         | < 70%           | 70-90%         | > 90%          | Log rotation + cleanup      | Expandir volumen + alerta        |
| Conexiones BD | < 60%           | 60-80%         | > 80%          | Reducir pool timeout        | Reject connections + retry       |
| Queue depth   | < 100           | 100-1000       | > 1000         | Agregar worker              | Reject encolado + alerta         |
| Requests/s    | < 70% capacidad | 70-90%         | > 90%          | Activar cache agresivo      | Rate limiting global             |

# 12. Arquitectura de Seguridad

## 12.1 Vision General de Seguridad

La arquitectura de seguridad de **SW-AOE** implementa el modelo **Defense in Depth** con multiples capas de proteccion superpuestas, siguiendo los principios de最小 privilegio, segregacion de funciones y seguridad por defecto. El sistema cumple con los estandares de ISO 27001, OWASP Top 10, NIST CSF.

```text
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         ARQUITECTURA DE SEGURIDAD POR CAPAS (Defense in Depth)
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ CAPA 1: PERIMETRO DE RED                               │
  │  WAF | DDoS Protection | IP Whitelisting | Geo-blocking │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ CAPA 2: TRANSPORTE                                     │
  │  TLS 1.3 | HSTS | Certificate Pinning | mTLS           │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ CAPA 3: APLICACION                                     │
  │  JWT + RBAC | CSRF Protection | Rate Limiting | CORS    │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ CAPA 4: VALIDACION DE INPUT                            │
  │  Zod Schemas | XSS Sanitization | SQL Injection Guard   │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ CAPA 5: DATOS                                          │
  │  AES-256-GCM | Field-level Encryption | Key Rotation    │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ CAPA 6: AUDITORIA                                      │
  │  Immutable Audit Log | Tamper Detection | SIEM Feed    │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 12.2 Modelo de Amenazas (STRIDE)

| Categoria STRIDE       | Amenaza                   | Vector de Ataque                   | Impacto | Probabilidad | Riesgo  | Mitigacion                                     |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------- | ------------ | ------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Spoofing               | Suplantacion de identidad | JWT robado o forjado               | Critico | Media        | Alto    | JWT firma RS256 + rotation + blacklist         |
| Tampering              | Modificacion de datos     | Man-in-the-middle, input malicioso | Critico | Baja         | Medio   | TLS 1.3 + parameterized queries + HMAC         |
| Repudiation            | Negacion de acciones      | Falta de trail de auditoria        | Alto    | Media        | Alto    | Immutable audit log + digital signatures       |
| Information Disclosure | Fuga de informacion       | Logs verbosos, API responses       | Critico | Media        | Critico | Data masking + PII encryption + RBAC           |
| Denial of Service      | Denegacion de servicio    | DDoS, queries pesadas              | Alto    | Alta         | Critico | Rate limiting + WAF + circuit breakers         |
| Elevation of Privilege | Escalada de privilegios   | Token manipulation, IDOR           | Critico | Baja         | Alto    | RBAC validation + principle of least privilege |

## 12.3 Autenticacion

| Aspecto                     | Implementacion                          | Configuracion                  | Verificacion                   |
| --------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------ |
| Protocolo                   | OAuth 2.0 + OpenID Connect              | Authorization Code Flow + PKCE | Conformance test               |
| Proveedor                   | NextAuth.js / Auth.js                   | Credentials + OAuth providers  | Integration test               |
| Tokens                      | JWT RS256 (asymmetric)                  | Access: 15min, Refresh: 7d     | Signature verification         |
| Almacenamiento de passwords | bcrypt hash                             | Cost factor: 12 ( rounds)      | Timing attack test             |
| MFA                         | TOTP (Google Authenticator)             | Backup codes: 10               | Enrollment + verification test |
| Session management          | Stateless JWT + refresh token rotation  | Refresh token rotation on use  | Token replay test              |
| Account lockout             | 5 failed attempts -> 15 min lock        | Progressive delay              | Brute force test               |
| Password policy             | Min 12 chars, upper+lower+digit+special | NIST SP 800-63B compliant      | Password strength test         |

## 12.4 Autorizacion (RBAC)

| Rol         | Permisos                                        | Acceso API                             | Acceso Datos                           | Limitaciones                          |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Super Admin | Todos los permisos del sistema                  | Todos los endpoints                    | Todos los proyectos y datos            | Solo configurado via console          |
| Admin       | Gestion de usuarios, configuracion del proyecto | CRUD + admin endpoints                 | Datos de sus proyectos asignados       | No puede eliminar organizacion        |
| Manager     | Gestion de contenido y usuarios del proyecto    | CRUD de modulos asignados              | Datos del proyecto + modulos asignados | No puede crear usuarios admin         |
| Editor      | Crear y editar contenido                        | POST, PUT, GET endpoints               | Datos de modulos asignados             | No puede eliminar ni cambiar permisos |
| Viewer      | Solo lectura de contenido                       | Solo GET endpoints                     | Datos de modulos asignados             | No puede modificar nada               |
| API Service | Acceso programatico limitado                    | Endpoints marcados como API-accessible | Solo datos del propio servicio         | Rate limiting estricto, sin UI        |

## 12.5 Proteccion de Datos

### 12.5.1 Encriptacion en Transito

| Protocolo        | Version  | Cipher Suites                                        | Key Exchange         | Certificate               |
| ---------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------------- |
| HTTPS            | TLS 1.3  | TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 | ECDHE (P-256, P-384) | DigiCert EV / Let Encrypt |
| DB Connection    | TLS 1.3  | TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384                               | ECDHE                | Self-signed CA internal   |
| Redis Connection | TLS 1.2+ | AES128-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256                  | ECDHE                | Self-signed CA internal   |
| Internal mTLS    | TLS 1.3  | TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256                               | mTLS cert pairs      | Internal CA               |

### 12.5.2 Encriptacion en Reposo

| Tipo de Dato        | Algoritmo   | Key Length | Key Rotation | Key Storage          | Performance Impact       |
| ------------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ------------ | -------------------- | ------------------------ |
| PII (nombre, email) | AES-256-GCM | 256 bit    | 90 dias      | HashiCorp Vault      | Minimal (< 1ms overhead) |
| Credenciales        | AES-256-GCM | 256 bit    | 30 dias      | HashiCorp Vault      | Minimal                  |
| Tokens/session      | AES-256-GCM | 256 bit    | 7 dias       | Vault transit engine | Minimal                  |
| Archivos            | AES-256-CBC | 256 bit    | Anual        | KMS / Vault          | Moderate (streaming)     |
| Backups             | AES-256-GCM | 256 bit    | Por backup   | Vault sealed key     | N/A (batch)              |

### 12.5.3 Clasificacion de Datos

| Clasificacion | Descripcion                      | Ejemplos                                        | Controles               | Retencion  | Disposicion               |
| ------------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------- |
| Publico       | Datos disponibles publicamente   | Documentacion, terminos de uso                  | Integridad              | Indefinida | N/A                       |
| Interno       | Uso interno de la organizacion   | Nombres de proyecto, metricas internas          | Acceso restringido      | 3 anos     | Secure delete             |
| Confidencial  | Informacion sensible del negocio | Roadmap financiero, contratos                   | Encrypted + RBAC        | 7 anos     | Secure wipe + certificado |
| Restringido   | PII, datos regulados             | Datos de usuarios, historial medico, financiero | Encrypted + audit + MFA | Regulado   | Crypto-shred              |

## 12.6 Seguridad de APIs

| Control          | Implementacion                   | Configuracion                                                           | Header/Parametro                         | Excepcion                         |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| Rate Limiting    | Token bucket algorithm           | 30 req/min usuario, 100 req/min API                                     | X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining | Endpoints de salud                |
| CORS             | Strict origin checking           | Allow specific origins only                                             | Access-Control-Allow-Origin              | Health check endpoints            |
| CSP              | Content-Security-Policy          | default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' | Content-Security-Policy header           | Admin panel (needs unsafe-inline) |
| HSTS             | HTTP Strict Transport Security   | max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload                            | Strict-Transport-Security                | N/A                               |
| CSRF             | Double submit cookie + SameSite  | SameSite=Strict, CSRF token                                             | X-CSRF-Token                             | API endpoints (Bearer token)      |
| XSS Prevention   | DOMPurify + output encoding      | Sanitize all user input                                                 | X-XSS-Protection: 0                      | N/A                               |
| Input Validation | Zod schemas server-side          | Strict schemas per endpoint                                             | N/A                                      | N/A                               |
| SQL Injection    | Prisma ORM parameterized queries | All queries via Prisma                                                  | N/A                                      | N/A                               |

## 12.7 Auditoria y Logging de Seguridad

| Evento Auditado             | Datos Capturados                       | Retencion | Almacenamiento  | Inmutabilidad | Revision  |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | --------- | --------------- | ------------- | --------- |
| Login exitoso               | userId, IP, user-agent, timestamp      | 2 anos    | Append-only log | SHA-256 chain | Semanal   |
| Login fallido               | email (masked), IP, timestamp          | 2 anos    | Append-only log | SHA-256 chain | Semanal   |
| Cambios de permisos         | userId, targetId, oldRole, newRole     | 7 anos    | Append-only log | SHA-256 chain | Inmediata |
| Acceso a datos restringidos | userId, resourceId, action             | 2 anos    | Append-only log | SHA-256 chain | Semanal   |
| Exportacion de datos        | userId, format, recordCount            | 7 anos    | Append-only log | SHA-256 chain | Inmediata |
| Cambios de configuracion    | userId, settingKey, oldValue, newValue | 7 anos    | Append-only log | SHA-256 chain | Inmediata |
| Eliminacion de datos        | userId, resourceId, dataFingerprint    | 7 anos    | Append-only log | SHA-256 chain | Inmediata |

## 12.8 Gestión de Vulnerabilidades

| Etapas                   | Herramienta              | Frecuencia  | Automatizacion    | Responsable   | SLA de Resolucion        |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------ | ----------- | ----------------- | ------------- | ------------------------ |
| SAST (Analisis estatico) | SonarQube / Snyk         | Cada commit | CI pipeline       | DevOps        | P0: 24h, P1: 7d          |
| DAST (Analisis dinamico) | OWASP ZAP                | Semanal     | Pipeline nocturno | Security      | P0: 48h, P1: 14d         |
| Dependency Scan          | npm audit + Snyk         | Cada commit | CI pipeline       | DevOps        | Critical: 24h            |
| Container Scan           | Trivy / Grype            | Cada build  | CI pipeline       | DevOps        | Critical: bloquea deploy |
| Pentesting               | Manual + automated       | Trimestral  | Semi-automated    | External firm | Criticos: 48h            |
| Secrets Scan             | git-secrets / trufflehog | Cada commit | Pre-commit hook   | All devs      | Inmediato (bloquea)      |

## 12.9 Incident Response

| Severidad       | Definicion                                   | Tiempo Respuesta | Tiempo Resolucion | Escalacion           | Comunicacion       |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ----------------- | -------------------- | ------------------ |
| SEV-1 (Critica) | Brecha de datos, sistema caido               | < 15 min         | < 4 horas         | CTO + Legal + PR     | Stakeholders en 1h |
| SEV-2 (Alta)    | Vulnerabilidad explotable, degradacion mayor | < 30 min         | < 24 horas        | Tech Lead + Security | Equipo en 4h       |
| SEV-3 (Media)   | Vulnerabilidad no explotable, feature rota   | < 4 horas        | < 1 semana        | Tech Lead            | Sprint review      |
| SEV-4 (Baja)    | Issue cosmético, documentacion               | < 24 horas       | < 2 sprints       | Asignado dev         | Backlog            |
