# 13. Observabilidad

## 13.1 Stack de Observabilidad

La estrategia de observabilidad de SW-AOE sigue los tres pilares: **Metricas**, **Logs** y **Traces**, implementados con el stack Prometheus + Grafana + Loki + Tempo. El objetivo es alcanzar un MTTD (Mean Time To Detect) menor a 5 minutos y un MTTR (Mean Time To Resolve) menor a 30 minutos.

```text
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
              STACK DE OBSERVABILIDAD (PROMETHEUS + GRAFANA)
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  INSTRUMENTACION                    RECOLECCION
  ┌────────────────────┐            ┌─────────────────────┐
  │ OpenTelemetry SDK  │───────────│ Prometheus Agent     │
  │ Custom Metrics     │            │ (pull cada 15s)      │
  │ Business Metrics   │            └──────────┬──────────┘
  │ Health Checks      │                       │
  └────────────────────┘            ┌──────────▼──────────┐
                                      │ Prometheus TSDB     │
  LOGS                                │ (15 dias retencion)  │
  ┌────────────────────┐            └──────────┬──────────┘
  │ pino / winston     │                       │
  │ Structured JSON    │            ┌──────────▼──────────┐
  │ Correlation IDs    │───────────│ Loki Log Aggregator  │
  └────────────────────┘            └──────────┬──────────┘
                                                  │
  TRACES                                           │
  ┌────────────────────┐            ┌──────────────▼───────┐
  │ OpenTelemetry      │───────────│ Tempo (Jaeger compat) │
  │ Trace Context      │            └──────────────┬───────┘
  └────────────────────┘                           │
                                                   │
  VISUALIZACION Y ALERTAS                          │
  ┌────────────────────┐            ┌──────────────▼───────┐
  │ Grafana Dashboards │◄───────────│ AlertManager          │
  │ On-Call SLO Panels │            │ PagerDuty / Slack     │
  └────────────────────┘            └──────────────────────┘
```

## 13.2 Metricas

### 13.2.1 Metricas de Infraestructura (RED Method)

| Metrica                        | Tipo Prometheus | Labels                                | Objetivo         | Alerta           | Dashboard         |
| ------------------------------ | --------------- | ------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------- | ----------------- |
| http_requests_total            | Counter         | method, endpoint, status_code, module | N/A (counter)    | Error rate > 1%  | API Overview      |
| http_request_duration_seconds  | Histogram       | method, endpoint, module              | p95 < 200ms      | p95 > 500ms      | Latency Heatmap   |
| http_requests_in_progress      | Gauge           | endpoint, module                      | < 100 concurrent | > 500 concurrent | Concurrency Panel |
| process_cpu_user_seconds_total | Counter         | instance                              | < 50% avg        | > 80% por 5 min  | Node Resources    |
| process_resident_memory_bytes  | Gauge           | instance                              | < 4 GB           | > 6 GB           | Node Resources    |
| node_filesystem_avail_bytes    | Gauge           | instance, mountpoint                  | > 20% free       | < 10% free       | Disk Usage        |

### 13.2.2 Metricas de Aplicacion (USE Method)

| Metrica                        | Tipo      | Labels                    | Objetivo       | Alerta                 |
| ------------------------------ | --------- | ------------------------- | -------------- | ---------------------- |
| app_business_operations_total  | Counter   | operation, module, status | N/A            | Failure rate > 0.5%    |
| app_cache_hits_total           | Counter   | module, cache_type        | Hit rate > 80% | Hit rate < 60%         |
| app_db_query_duration_seconds  | Histogram | operation, table, module  | avg < 20ms     | avg > 100ms            |
| app_db_pool_active_connections | Gauge     | module                    | < 20           | > 40                   |
| app_auth_tokens_issued_total   | Counter   | grant_type                | N/A            | Anomalia > 3x baseline |
| app_background_jobs_total      | Counter   | job_type, module, status  | N/A            | Failure rate > 5%      |
| app_background_queue_depth     | Gauge     | job_type, module          | < 100          | > 1000                 |
| app_external_api_calls_total   | Counter   | service, status           | N/A            | Error rate > 5%        |

# 14. Tolerancia a Fallos

## 14.1 Vision General de Resiliencia

La estrategia de tolerancia a fallos de SW-AOE implementa multiples capas de proteccion para garantizar que el sistema siga operando, degradandose de forma graceful ante fallos parciales, en lugar de fallar de forma catastrofica. El objetivo es una disponibilidad del 99.9% (8.76 horas de downtime maximo anual).

## 14.2 Patrones de Resiliencia

| Patron               | Descripcion                          | Implementacion                        | Componente                       | Configuracion                   |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| Retry                | Reintentar operaciones transitorias  | Exponential backoff + jitter          | Repository, HTTP Client          | 3 retries, 100ms-5s backoff     |
| Circuit Breaker      | Abrir circuito ante fallos repetidos | State machine (Closed/Open/Half-Open) | External service adapters        | 5 failures -> open 30s          |
| Timeout              | Limitar tiempo de espera             | Configurable timeouts per operation   | Todas las operaciones I/O        | DB: 5s, HTTP: 30s, Cache: 100ms |
| Bulkhead             | Aislar recursos entre modulos        | Connection pools separados            | Prisma connections, Thread pools | Max 20 connections per pool     |
| Rate Limiter         | Limitar la carga entrante            | Token bucket algorithm                | API middleware                   | 30 req/min user, 100/min API    |
| Graceful Degradation | Desactivar features no criticas      | Feature flags + health checks         | Feature service                  | Disable if unhealthy 60s        |
| Health Check         | Monitorear estado de dependencias    | Liveness + readiness probes           | Health service                   | Check cada 15-30s               |
| Fallback             | Valores por defecto ante fallos      | Cache stale data + static responses   | Service layer                    | TTL 5 min stale data            |
| Saga Pattern         | Compensacion en procesos largos      | Choreography saga                     | Domain services                  | Compensate within 30 min        |

## 14.3 High Availability (HA)

| Componente     | Configuracion HA                           | Failover                          | RTO     | RPO           | Estado Actual    |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------- | ------- | ------------- | ---------------- |
| App Servers    | 3+ instancias detras LB                    | LB elimina instancia no saludable | < 30s   | 0 (stateless) | Roadmap (Fase 2) |
| PostgreSQL     | Primary + Replicas + Streaming Replication | Auto-promote replica (Patroni)    | < 60s   | < 1s (sync)   | Roadmap (Fase 2) |
| Redis          | Sentinel (3 nodos) / Cluster               | Auto-failover via Sentinel        | < 30s   | < 1s          | Roadmap (Fase 2) |
| Load Balancer  | Caddy (active-passive)                     | DNS failover + keepalived         | < 60s   | 0             | Implementado     |
| Object Storage | S3 / MinIO (replicated)                    | Multi-region replication          | < 5 min | < 1s          | Roadmap (Fase 3) |

## 14.4 Escenarios de Fallo y Respuesta

| Escenario             | Deteccion                   | Respuesta Automatica             | Impacto Usuario                | MTTR       | MTTD       |
| --------------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------- | ---------- |
| App server crash      | PM2 process monitor         | PM2 auto-restart (< 3s)          | Request actual falla, retry OK | < 30s      | < 5s       |
| Base de datos caida   | Health check timeout        | Circuit breaker + fallback cache | Datos stale cache (5 min)      | < 5 min    | < 15s      |
| Redis caido           | Health check timeout        | Graceful degradation (direct DB) | Mayor latencia, sin cache      | < 2 min    | < 5s       |
| Disco lleno           | Disk usage alert (> 85%)    | Log rotation + temp cleanup      | Exportaciones fallan           | < 15 min   | < 1 min    |
| Red parcial caida     | Network partition detection | Retry + queue offline            | Operaciones encoladas          | Variable   | < 30s      |
| Memory leak           | Memory monitoring (> 80%)   | PM2 restart when > threshold     | Interrupcion momentanea        | < 1 min    | < 2 min    |
| Excepcion no manejada | Global error handler        | Log + graceful error response    | Operacion fallida              | N/A (auto) | < 1s       |
| Despliegue fallido    | Smoke test post-deploy      | Auto-rollback a version previa   | Cero impacto (blue-green)      | < 2 min    | < 30s      |
| Certificado expirado  | Certificate expiry monitor  | Auto-renewal (ACME)              | N/A si auto-renew funciona     | < 1 hora   | < 24 horas |
| DDoS attack           | Traffic anomaly detection   | WAF rate limiting + CDN absorb   | Degradacion temporal           | < 5 min    | < 1 min    |

## 14.5 Estrategia de Backup y Recovery

| Tipo             | Frecuencia           | Retencion     | Destino                           | Verificacion                | RTO      | RPO           |
| ---------------- | -------------------- | ------------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------- | ------------- |
| Incremental DB   | Cada hora            | 24 horas      | Local + remote object storage     | Checksum post-backup        | < 30 min | < 1 hora      |
| Full DB Backup   | Diario (02:00 AM)    | 30 dias       | Remote object storage (encrypted) | Restore drill mensual       | < 1 hora | < 24 horas    |
| WAL Archive      | Continuo             | 7 dias        | Remote object storage             | Point-in-time recovery test | < 30 min | < 5 min       |
| Config + Secrets | En cada deploy       | 6 meses (Git) | Git repository + Vault            | Diff review en deploy       | < 5 min  | < 1 deploy    |
| Media Files      | Diario (incremental) | 90 dias       | Object storage (versioned)        | Sample restore trimestral   | < 1 hora | < 24 horas    |
| Audit Logs       | Continuo             | 7 anos        | Object storage (append-only)      | Integrity check semanal     | < 1 hora | 0 (inmutable) |

## 14.6 Chaos Engineering

| Experimento        | Inyeccion         | Resultado Esperado                       | Metrica de Exito     | Frecuencia | Herramienta   |
| ------------------ | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kill App Server    | docker kill       | LB redirige trafico, 0 downtime visible  | Error rate < 0.1%    | Mensual    | Manual script |
| DB Connection Drop | iptables DROP     | Circuit breaker se abre, fallback activa | Recovery < 30s       | Trimestral | Chaos Monkey  |
| Redis Failure      | docker stop redis | Degradation graceful sin crash           | Latencia < 3x normal | Trimestral | Manual script |
| High CPU Load      | stress-ng         | Auto-scaling activa si disponible        | Latencia < 2x normal | Mensual    | stress-ng     |
| Memory Pressure    | malloc flood      | GC agresivo + alerta temprana            | No OOM crash         | Mensual    | Custom script |
| Network Latency    | tc netem delay    | Timeouts respetados, retries funcionan   | Error rate < 1%      | Trimestral | tc / netem    |

## Tolerancia a Fallos — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de tolerancia a fallos. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Tolerancia a Fallos — MOD-01: Core Application Service

##### Patrones de Resiliencia del Modulo — Core Application Service

| Patron               | Aplicacion                       | Componente                                 | Configuracion                                | Fallback                      |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Retry                | Operaciones BD del modulo        | Core Application ServiceRepository         | 3 retries, exponential backoff 100ms-5s      | Queue para retry asincrono    |
| Circuit Breaker      | Llamadas a APIs externas         | Core Application ServiceIntegrationAdapter | 5 failures -> open 30s, half-open 3 requests | Datos cacheados (stale 5 min) |
| Timeout              | Todas las operaciones del modulo | Core Application ServiceService            | Read: 5s, Write: 10s, External: 30s          | Cache response si existe      |
| Bulkhead             | Connection pools del modulo      | Core Application ServiceRepository         | Max 20 connections, queue 50                 | HTTP 503 + Retry-After        |
| Graceful Degradation | Funciones no criticas            | Core Application ServiceFeatureService     | Configurable per feature                     | Static fallback + banner      |
| Health Check         | Estado de dependencias           | HealthService                              | Check cada 15s, unhealthy 3x -> disable      | Desactivar + alerta           |

##### Escenarios de Fallo del Modulo — Core Application Service

| Escenario                                         | Deteccion               | Recuperacion                     | Impacto en Usuario            | MTTR              |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ----------------- |
| BD no disponible para Core Application Service    | Health check timeout 5s | Circuit breaker + cache fallback | Datos leidos de cache (stale) | < 5 min           |
| Cache no disponible para Core Application Service | Ping timeout 2s         | Operar sin cache (direct DB)     | Mayor latencia tolerable      | < 2 min           |
| Worker de Core Application Service caido          | PM2 process monitor     | PM2 auto-restart                 | Jobs encolados re-procesados  | < 1 min           |
| Rate limit alcanzado en Core Application Service  | HTTP 429 response       | Client retry con backoff         | Operacion retardada           | N/A (client-side) |
| Concurrencia en Core Application Service          | Optimistic lock failure | Client reload + retry            | Advertencia al usuario        | N/A (client-side) |

# 15. Rendimiento

## 15.1 Budget de Rendimiento

El budget de rendimiento define los objetivos cuantitativos para cada dimension critica del sistema. Estos budget se verifican de forma continua en el pipeline de CI/CD y se reportan en los dashboards de observabilidad.

| Metrica                        | Budget (MVP) | Budget (V2) | Budget (Enterprise) | Alerta si excede | Medicion         |
| ------------------------------ | ------------ | ----------- | ------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------- |
| First Contentful Paint (FCP)   | < 1.5s       | < 1.0s      | < 0.8s              | p75 > 2.0s       | Lighthouse + RUM |
| Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) | < 2.5s       | < 2.0s      | < 1.5s              | p75 > 3.5s       | Lighthouse + RUM |
| Time to Interactive (TTI)      | < 3.0s       | < 2.0s      | < 1.5s              | p75 > 4.0s       | Lighthouse       |
| Total Blocking Time (TBT)      | < 300ms      | < 200ms     | < 100ms             | p75 > 500ms      | Lighthouse       |
| Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)  | < 0.1        | < 0.05      | < 0.01              | p75 > 0.25       | RUM              |
| API Response (p50)             | < 100ms      | < 80ms      | < 50ms              | p50 > 200ms      | APM              |
| API Response (p95)             | < 200ms      | < 150ms     | < 100ms             | p95 > 500ms      | APM              |
| API Response (p99)             | < 500ms      | < 300ms     | < 200ms             | p99 > 1000ms     | APM              |
| Database Query (avg)           | < 20ms       | < 10ms      | < 5ms               | avg > 50ms       | Postgres EXPLAIN |
| Database Query (p95)           | < 100ms      | < 50ms      | < 20ms              | p95 > 200ms      | Postgres EXPLAIN |
| Page Weight (total)            | < 500KB      | < 300KB     | < 200KB             | > 1MB            | Webpack Analyzer |
| JS Bundle Size                 | < 200KB      | < 150KB     | < 100KB             | > 300KB gzipped  | Bundlewatch      |
| CSS Bundle Size                | < 50KB       | < 30KB      | < 20KB              | > 80KB           | Bundlewatch      |
| Time to First Byte (TTFB)      | < 500ms      | < 300ms     | < 200ms             | p75 > 800ms      | RUM              |
| Memory Usage (server)          | < 2GB        | < 4GB       | < 8GB               | > 80% disponible | PM2 Monitor      |
| CPU Usage (server avg)         | < 50%        | < 60%       | < 70%               | > 80% por 5 min  | Prometheus       |

## 15.2 Perfil de Carga Esperado

| Escenario    | Usuarios Concurrentes | RPS       | Duracion   | Patron de Carga          | Objetivo                                |
| ------------ | --------------------- | --------- | ---------- | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------- |
| Basico (MVP) | 50                    | 50        | 1 hora     | Constante                | Todos los budget cumplidos              |
| Normal (V2)  | 500                   | 500       | 2 horas    | Constante + picos 10%    | Todos los budget cumplidos              |
| Pico         | 2,000                 | 2,000     | 30 minutos | Ramp-up 0->2000 en 5 min | p95 < 2x baseline                       |
| Estres       | 5,000                 | 5,000     | 1 hora     | Constante alto           | Degradacion graceful, 0 crashes         |
| Endurance    | 500                   | 500       | 24 horas   | Constante                | Sin memory leaks, estable               |
| Spike        | 10,000                | 10,000    | 5 minutos  | Instantaneo              | Rate limiting + queue, recovery < 1 min |
| Breakpoint   | Escalable             | Escalable | Variable   | Incremento 10%/min       | Encontrar limite con degradation        |

## 15.3 Optimizaciones de Base de Datos

| Optimizacion                     | Impacto                    | Implementacion                          | Verificacion                | Prioridad |
| -------------------------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | --------- |
| Connection pooling               | Latencia de conexion -80%  | Prisma pool: min=5, max=20              | Monitoring pool utilization | P0        |
| Indexacion de queries frecuentes | Queries -90% tiempo        | EXPLAIN ANALYZE + indices BTREE         | Slow query log < 10/min     | P0        |
| Query optimization               | Queries complejas -50%     | JOIN optimization, subquery elimination | p95 < 50ms                  | P0        |
| Read replicas                    | Read throughput +300%      | Streaming replication, read splitting   | Replication lag < 1s        | P1        |
| Prepared statements              | CPU BD -20%                | Prisma (uses prepared statements)       | CPU monitoring              | P0        |
| Partial indexes                  | Index size -60%            | WHERE clauses en indices                | Index size monitoring       | P1        |
| VACUUM tuning                    | Scan performance +30%      | auto_vacuum tuned                       | Dead tuples < 1%            | P2        |
| Connection timeouts              | Pool exhaustion prevention | statement_timeout: 30s                  | No hung connections         | P0        |

## 15.4 Optimizaciones de Frontend

| Optimizacion       | Impacto                    | Implementacion                                | Metrica                  | Prioridad |
| ------------------ | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | --------- |
| SSR + Streaming    | FCP -40%, LCP -30%         | Next.js streaming + Suspense                  | FCP < 1.0s, LCP < 2.0s   | P0        |
| Code splitting     | JS bundle -60%             | Dynamic imports + React.lazy                  | Initial JS < 200KB       | P0        |
| Image optimization | Transfer size -70%         | Next.js Image + WebP + lazy load              | LCP < 2.0s               | P0        |
| Font optimization  | CLS elimination            | next/font + font-display: swap                | CLS < 0.1                | P0        |
| Caching HTTP       | Repeat visits -80%         | Cache-Control + ETag + stale-while-revalidate | TTFB < 200ms (cached)    | P1        |
| Tree shaking       | Bundle size -30%           | ESM imports, sideEffects: false               | Unused code < 5%         | P1        |
| Virtual scrolling  | DOM nodes -90% para listas | react-window / TanStack Virtual               | FPS > 30 con 10000 items | P2        |
| Prefetching        | Navigacion instantanea     | Next.js Link prefetch + router                | TTFB navigation < 100ms  | P1        |

## 15.5 Optimizaciones de API

| Optimizacion         | Impacto                    | Implementacion                          | Metrica                             | Prioridad |
| -------------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | --------- |
| Response compression | Transfer size -70%         | gzip/brotli en Caddy                    | Response size < 10KB avg            | P0        |
| Pagination           | Memory -90% para listas    | Cursor-based pagination                 | p95 < 200ms para cualquier pagina   | P0        |
| Field selection      | Transfer size -50%         | ?fields=name,status (sparse fieldsets)  | Response time proporcional a fields | P2        |
| Eager loading        | N+1 queries eliminadas     | Prisma include / select                 | 0 N+1 queries                       | P0        |
| Batch endpoints      | Throughput +500% para bulk | /bulk POST con array de items           | 1000 items < 5s                     | P1        |
| ETag caching         | 304 responses para GET     | If-None-Match / ETag header             | Cache hit rate > 30%                | P1        |
| Async processing     | User-facing latency -80%   | Background jobs para operaciones largas | User response < 500ms               | P1        |

## 15.6 Plan de Pruebas de Rendimiento

| Test                 | Herramienta             | Frecuencia | Ejecucion         | Criterio de Aceptacion                |
| -------------------- | ----------------------- | ---------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Load Test Basico     | k6                      | Cada PR    | CI pipeline       | p95 < 200ms, 0 errores, RPS >= target |
| Stress Test          | k6                      | Semanal    | Pipeline nocturno | Graceful degradation, 0 crashes       |
| Endurance Test       | k6                      | Mensual    | Staging weekend   | Sin memory leaks, estable 24h         |
| Spike Test           | k6                      | Mensual    | Staging           | Recovery < 1 min, no data loss        |
| Lighthouse CI        | Lighthouse              | Cada PR    | CI pipeline       | Performance > 90, PWA > 90            |
| Bundle Analysis      | webpack-bundle-analyzer | Cada PR    | CI pipeline       | No bundle size regression > 5%        |
| Database Performance | pg_stat_statements      | Continuo   | Monitoring        | No query > 1s in production           |

# 16. Referencias de Decisiones Arquitectonicas (ADR)

## 16.1 Decisiones Arquitectonicas Globales

Las siguientes decisiones arquitectonicas guian el diseno de **SW-AOE** en su totalidad. Cada ADR sigue el formato Michael Nygard: Contexto, Decision, Consecuencias y Alternativas.

| ADR     | Titulo                                   | Estado   | Contexto                                           | Decision                               | Alternativas                   | Consecuencias                       | Fecha      |
| ------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | ---------- |
| ADR-001 | Monolito Modular vs Microservicios       | Aceptada | Equipo 5-10 devs, ACID necesario, iteracion rapida | Monolito Modular con extraccion futura | Microservicios, Event-Driven   | Mas simple, escalabilidad limitada  | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-002 | PostgreSQL como base de datos primaria   | Aceptada | ACID, JSONB, madurez, ecosistema rico              | PostgreSQL 16.x                        | MySQL 8, MongoDB, SQLite       | ACID garantizado, overhead vs NoSQL | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-003 | JWT para autenticacion stateless         | Aceptada | Escalabilidad, multi-platform, mobile-ready        | JWT RS256 con refresh rotation         | Session-based, OAuth2-only     | Stateless, revocacion compleja      | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-004 | REST como protocolo de API               | Aceptada | Simplicidad, caching natural, tooling maduro       | REST + JSON + OpenAPI                  | GraphQL, gRPC, tRPC            | Over-fetching posible               | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-005 | Next.js 16 como framework fullstack      | Aceptada | SSR, streaming, unified frontend/backend           | Next.js App Router                     | Remix, Nuxt, Angular Universal | Acoplado a Vercel ecosystem         | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-006 | Prisma ORM para acceso a datos           | Aceptada | Type safety, migraciones automaticas               | Prisma 6.x                             | TypeORM, Drizzle, Raw SQL      | DX superior, raw perf overhead      | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-007 | Zod para validacion TypeScript-first     | Aceptada | Type inference, shared schemas client/server       | Zod 3.x                                | Yup, Joi, class-validator      | Bundle size pequeno                 | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-008 | Zustand para gestion de estado           | Aceptada | API minimal, performante, TypeScript-first         | Zustand 5.x                            | Redux Toolkit, Jotai, Context  | Limitado para estado complejo       | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-009 | Tailwind CSS para estilos                | Aceptada | Consistencia, zero-conflict, utilidad              | Tailwind CSS 4.x                       | CSS Modules, Styled Components | Bundle size potencial               | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-010 | Prometheus + Grafana para observabilidad | Aceptada | Open-source, flexible, cost-effective              | Prometheus + Grafana + Loki + Tempo    | Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch | Self-hosted overhead                | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-011 | PM2 para process management              | Aceptada | Simple, battle-tested, zero-config clustering      | PM2 + pm2-runtime                      | Docker Swarm, Kubernetes       | Limitado a single-server            | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-012 | Caddy como reverse proxy                 | Aceptada | Auto-HTTPS, simple config, H2/3 support            | Caddy 2.x                              | Nginx, HAProxy, Traefik        | Menos config flexibility            | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-013 | Docker para contenedores                 | Aceptada | Reproducibilidad, CI/CD, isolation                 | Docker + Docker Compose                | Podman, bare metal             | Overhead de contenedores            | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-014 | GitHub Actions para CI/CD                | Aceptada | Native GitHub integration, generous free tier      | GitHub Actions                         | GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI   | Vendor lock-in GitHub               | 2026-05-31 |
| ADR-015 | HashiCorp Vault para secrets             | Aceptada | Centralized secrets, rotation, audit               | Vault OSS / HCP                        | AWS Secrets Manager, .env      | Infra adicional                     | 2026-05-31 |

# 17. Riesgos

## 17.1 Metodologia de Evaluacion de Riesgos

Los riesgos se evaluan utilizando la matriz de probabilidad vs impacto, resultando en un score de riesgo que determina la estrategia de mitigacion. La escala es de 1 (muy bajo) a 5 (critico), donde el score se calcula como Probabilidad x Impacto.

```text
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                    MATRIZ DE RIESGOS (Heat Map)
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  IMPACTO ▶         Bajo(1)        Medio(2)       Alto(3)       Critico(4)
  PROBABILIDAD ▼
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Alta (4)          [AMARILLO]     [NARANJA]      [ROJO]        [ROJO]
                    R-Medio        R-Alto         R-Critico     R-Critico

  Media (3)         [VERDE]        [AMARILLO]     [NARANJA]     [ROJO]
                    R-Bajo         R-Medio        R-Alto        R-Critico

  Baja (2)          [VERDE]        [VERDE]        [AMARILLO]    [NARANJA]
                    R-Bajo         R-Bajo         R-Medio       R-Alto

  Muy Baja (1)      [VERDE]        [VERDE]        [VERDE]       [AMARILLO]
                    R-Bajo         R-Bajo         R-Bajo        R-Medio

  Leyenda: [VERDE] = Aceptar | [AMARILLO] = Monitorizar | [NARANJA] = Mitigar | [ROJO] = Escalar
```

| ID    | Riesgo                                                    | Categoria       | Prob. | Impacto | Score        | Estrategia | Mitigacion                                               | Contingencia                         | Propietario   |
| ----- | --------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | ----- | ------- | ------------ | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------- |
| R-001 | Complejidad subestimada del proyecto                      | Tecnico         | 4     | 4       | 16 (Critico) | Mitigar    | Prototipado temprano, spikes, MVP incremental            | Reducir alcance, externalizar modulo | Tech Lead     |

| R-004 | Perdida de personal clave                                 | Organizacional  | 4     | 3       | 12 (Alto)    | Mitigar    | Documentacion exhaustiva, pair programming, code review  | Contratacion temporal, consulting    | Eng. Manager  |
| R-005 | Rendimiento insuficiente bajo carga                       | Tecnico         | 3     | 3       | 9 (Medio)    | Mitigar    | Load testing desde fases tempranas, profiling continuo   | Auto-scaling + caching agresivo      | Backend Lead  |

| R-009 | Deuda tecnica acumulada excesiva                          | Tecnico         | 4     | 2       | 8 (Medio)    | Aceptar    | 20% de sprint capacity para deuda tecnica                | Refactoring sprint dedicado          | Tech Lead     |

# 18. Evolucion Futura

## 18.1 Roadmap de Evolucion Arquitectonica

```text
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
              ROADMAP DE EVOLUCION ARQUITECTONICA
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  FASE 1: MVP (Semanas 1-16)          FASE 2: Crecimiento (Meses 5-9)
  ─────────────────────────           ──────────────────────────────
  • Monolito modular base             • Redis cluster distribuido
  • PostgreSQL single instance        • Read replicas (2-3)
  • In-memory cache                   • CDN para assets estaticos
  • PM2 cluster (4 workers)           • Auto-scaling basico
  • Logging basico                    • Grafana dashboards avanzados
  • CI/CD pipeline                    • Performance optimization
  • Auth JWT + RBAC                   • Rate limiting avanzado
                                      • Batch processing system

  FASE 3: Escala (Meses 10-18)        FASE 4: Enterprise (Meses 19-30)
  ─────────────────────────           ──────────────────────────────
  • Extraccion de microservicios       • Multi-region deployment
  • Event-driven architecture          • Event sourcing + CQRS
  • Kubernetes orchestration           • Service mesh (Istio)
  • Database sharding                  • Chaos engineering
  • Advanced observability             • AI/ML pipeline integration
  • Zero-downtime deploys              • Compliance automation
  • Feature flags system               • API marketplace
```

## 18.2 Fase 1: MVP y Estabilizacion (Meses 1-4)

| Item              | Descripcion                          | Prioridad | Esfuerzo        | Dependencies      | Entregable             |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------ | --------- | --------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------- |
| Core Architecture | Monolito modular base con 5 capas    | P0        | 40 story points | None              | Arquitectura operativa |
| Authentication    | JWT + RBAC + NextAuth.js             | P0        | 20 story points | Core Architecture | Auth funcional         |
| Database Layer    | PostgreSQL + Prisma + migraciones    | P0        | 25 story points | Core Architecture | Schema + queries       |
| CI/CD Pipeline    | GitHub Actions + Docker + deploy     | P0        | 15 story points | None              | Pipeline operativo     |
| Basic Monitoring  | Logs estructurados + health checks   | P1        | 10 story points | CI/CD             | Dashboards basicos     |
| Security Baseline | WAF, rate limiting, input validation | P0        | 15 story points | Auth + CI/CD      | SAST integrado         |

## 18.3 Fase 2: Crecimiento y Optimizacion (Meses 5-9)

| Item                     | Descripcion                                | Prioridad | Esfuerzo        | Dependencies      | Entregable               |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | --------- | --------------- | ----------------- | ------------------------ |
| Redis Distributed Cache  | Migrar de in-memory a Redis cluster        | P1        | 20 story points | Fase 1 estable    | Cache distribuido        |
| Read Replicas            | 2-3 replicas PostgreSQL para lecturas      | P1        | 15 story points | Fase 1 estable    | Read scaling             |
| Advanced Observability   | Prometheus + Grafana + Loki + Tempo        | P1        | 25 story points | Monitoring basico | Full stack observability |
| CDN Integration          | CloudFlare para assets y API cache         | P2        | 10 story points | DNS configurado   | Edge caching             |
| Performance Optimization | Query optimization + caching + compression | P1        | 20 story points | Observability     | p95 < 200ms              |
| Batch Processing         | Sistema de jobs asincronos                 | P2        | 15 story points | Redis             | Worker pool operativo    |
| Search Engine            | PostgreSQL tsvector o Elasticsearch        | P2        | 20 story points | Observability     | Full-text search         |

## 18.4 Fase 3: Escala y Microservicios (Meses 10-18)

| Item                      | Descripcion                                  | Prioridad | Esfuerzo        | Dependencies   | Entregable                |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------------- | -------------- | ------------------------- |
| Service Extraction        | Extraer modulos criticos como microservicios | P1        | 40 story points | Fase 2 estable | 1-3 microservicios        |
| Event-Driven Architecture | Message broker (RabbitMQ/Kafka)              | P1        | 30 story points | Microservicios | Event bus operativo       |
| Kubernetes Orchestration  | Migrar de PM2 a K8s                          | P2        | 35 story points | Docker + IaC   | K8s cluster operativo     |
| Database Sharding         | Particionar datos de alto volumen            | P2        | 25 story points | Fase 2 estable | Sharding configurado      |
| API Gateway               | Kong / Traefik como gateway                  | P1        | 15 story points | Microservicios | Gateway con rate limiting |
| Feature Flags             | LaunchDarkly / custom feature flags          | P2        | 10 story points | API Gateway    | Feature flags system      |
| Zero-Downtime Deploys     | Blue-green + canary a nivel de servicio      | P1        | 15 story points | K8s            | Deploys sin downtime      |

## 18.5 Fase 4: Enterprise (Meses 19-30)

| Item                    | Descripcion                                   | Prioridad | Esfuerzo        | Dependencies           | Entregable             |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------- |
| Multi-Region Deployment | Despliegue activo-activo en 2+ regiones       | P2        | 40 story points | K8s + Event-driven     | Multi-region HA        |
| Event Sourcing + CQRS   | Event store + proyecciones                    | P2        | 35 story points | Event bus              | Audit trail completo   |
| Service Mesh            | Istio para mTLS, observability, traffic mgmt  | P3        | 25 story points | K8s + Microservicios   | Mesh operativo         |
| Chaos Engineering       | Programa continuo de inyeccion de fallos      | P2        | 15 story points | Observability completa | Resilience verificada  |
| AI/ML Pipeline          | Integracion de modelos ML para automatizacion | P3        | 30 story points | Stable platform        | ML features live       |
| Compliance Automation   | Continuous compliance monitoring + reporting  | P2        | 20 story points | Seguridad madura       | Auto-compliance        |
| API Marketplace         | Publicacion de APIs para terceros             | P3        | 25 story points | API Gateway + OAuth    | API portal live        |
| Edge Computing          | Lambda@Edge / Cloudflare Workers              | P3        | 20 story points | Multi-region           | Edge functions activas |

## 18.6 Decisiones Arquitectonicas Postergadas

| Decision                     | Contexto                                       | Momento de Decision | Criterios                              | Alternativas en Consideracion    |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Monolito -> Microservicios   | Cuando el equipo supere 10 personas            | Mes 10-12           | Team autonomy, deployment independence | Extract modular services primero |
| SQL -> NoSQL (parcial)       | Cuando queries documentales dominen            | Mes 12-15           | Schema flexibility, query patterns     | MongoDB, DynamoDB                |
| Self-hosted -> Cloud Managed | Cuando el overhead operational supere el costo | Mes 15-20           | Total cost of ownership, team capacity | RDS, ElastiCache, CloudWatch     |
| On-premise -> Hybrid Cloud   | Si requisitos regulatorios lo exigen           | Depende de dominio  | Data sovereignty, compliance           | Multi-cloud, edge                |
| REST -> GraphQL              | Si los clientes necesitan flexibilidad extrema | Mes 18-24           | Client needs, query complexity         | GraphQL gateway sobre REST       |

## 18.7 Metricas de Madurez Arquitectonica

| Dimensión      | Nivel 1 (Inicial) | Nivel 2 (Gestionado) | Nivel 3 (Definido)       | Nivel 4 (Cuantitativo) | Nivel 5 (Optimizado)    |
| -------------- | ----------------- | -------------------- | ------------------------ | ---------------------- | ----------------------- |
| Despliegue     | Manual            | Scripted             | Automated CI/CD          | Zero-downtime deploy   | Self-healing            |
| Observabilidad | Console logs      | Structured logs      | Metrics + dashboards     | Traces + SLOs          | AIOps + predictive      |
| Seguridad      | Basic auth        | JWT + RBAC           | SAST + DAST + pentesting | Continuous compliance  | Threat intelligence     |
| Escalabilidad  | Single instance   | Vertical scaling     | Horizontal auto-scale    | Multi-region           | Auto-optimizing         |
| Testing        | Manual tests      | Unit + integration   | E2E + performance        | Chaos engineering      | Continuous verification |

# 19. Arquitectura de Despliegue Avanzada

Esta seccion detalla la infraestructura de despliegue avanzada del sistema **SW-AOE**, incluyendo configuraciones de Kubernetes, Helm charts, infraestructura como codigo con Terraform, y estrategias de despliegue avanzadas.

## 19.1 Manifiestos de Kubernetes

A continuacion se presentan los manifiestos de Kubernetes completos para cada componente critico del sistema:

### 19.1.1 Namespace y RBAC

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: sw-aoe-production
  labels:
    environment: production
    team: platform
    tier: application
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: app-service-account
  namespace: sw-aoe-production
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: app-role
  namespace: sw-aoe-production
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["", "apps", "batch"]
    resources: ["pods", "deployments", "jobs", "configmaps", "secrets"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch"]
  - apiGroups: ["autoscaling"]
    resources: ["horizontalpodautoscalers"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]

```

### 19.1.2 Deployment con Probes

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app-server
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app: sw-aoe
    version: v1
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sw-aoe
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: sw-aoe
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: app-service-account
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: registry.example.com/sw-aoe:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 1000m
              memory: 1Gi
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/health/live
              port: 3000
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/health/ready
              port: 3000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/health/live
              port: 3000
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 12

```

### 19.1.3 Horizontal Pod Autoscaler

```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: app-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: app-server
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 20
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: memory
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 80
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 2
          periodSeconds: 60
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 1
          periodSeconds: 120

```

## 19.2 Helm Chart Configuration

La siguiente tabla describe los valores configurables del Helm chart del sistema:

| Parametro                           | Default      | Descripcion                                   | Tipo    | Validacion                      |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------- |
| replicaCount                        | 3            | Numero de replicas del servidor de aplicacion | integer | 1-50                            |
| image.repository                    | registry/app | Repositorio de la imagen Docker               | string  | URL valida                      |
| image.tag                           | latest       | Tag de la imagen a desplegar                  | string  | semver                          |
| image.pullPolicy                    | IfNotPresent | Politica de pull de imagen                    | enum    | Always/IfNotPresent/Never       |
| service.type                        | ClusterIP    | Tipo de servicio de Kubernetes                | enum    | ClusterIP/NodePort/LoadBalancer |
| service.port                        | 3000         | Puerto expuesto por el servicio               | integer | 1-65535                         |
| resources.requests.cpu              | 250m         | CPU request por pod                           | string  | formato Kubernetes              |
| resources.requests.memory           | 512Mi        | Memoria request por pod                       | string  | formato Kubernetes              |
| resources.limits.cpu                | 1000m        | CPU limit por pod                             | string  | formato Kubernetes              |
| resources.limits.memory             | 1Gi          | Memoria limit por pod                         | string  | formato Kubernetes              |
| autoscaling.enabled                 | true         | Habilitar HPA                                 | boolean | true/false                      |
| autoscaling.minReplicas             | 3            | Replicas minimas                              | integer | 1-100                           |
| autoscaling.maxReplicas             | 20           | Replicas maximas                              | integer | 1-100                           |
| autoscaling.targetCPUUtilization    | 70           | Target de CPU para HPA (%)                    | integer | 1-100                           |
| autoscaling.targetMemoryUtilization | 80           | Target de memoria para HPA (%)                | integer | 1-100                           |
| nodeSelector.enabled                | false        | Habilitar node selector                       | boolean | true/false                      |
| tolerations                         | []           | Toleraciones para pod scheduling              | list    | YAML valido                     |
| affinity                            | {}           | Afinidad de pods/nodos                        | object  | YAML valido                     |
| ingress.enabled                     | true         | Habilitar ingress                             | boolean | true/false                      |
| ingress.className                   | nginx        | Clase del ingress controller                  | string  | nginx/traefik/istio             |
| ingress.tls.enabled                 | true         | Habilitar TLS en ingress                      | boolean | true/false                      |
| pdb.enabled                         | true         | Habilitar PodDisruptionBudget                 | boolean | true/false                      |
| pdb.minAvailable                    | 2            | Pods minimos disponibles durante disruption   | integer | 1-N                             |
| topologySpreadConstraints           | []           | Restricciones de spread topologico            | list    | YAML valido                     |

## 19.3 Terraform IaC - Infraestructura como Codigo

```hcl
# provider.tf
provider "aws" {
  region  = var.aws_region
  profile = var.aws_profile
  default_tags {
    tags = {
      Project     = "SW-AOE"
      Environment = var.environment
      ManagedBy   = "terraform"
      Team        = "platform"
    }
  }
}

# vpc.tf
resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = var.vpc_cidr
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
  enable_dns_support   = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.project_name}-vpc" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "private" {
  count             = length(var.availability_zones)
  vpc_id            = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block        = var.private_subnets[count.index]
  availability_zone = var.availability_zones[count.index]

  tags = { Name = "${var.project_name}-private-${count.index + 1}" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public" {
  count                   = length(var.availability_zones)
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = var.public_subnets[count.index]
  availability_zone       = var.availability_zones[count.index]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.project_name}-public-${count.index + 1}" }
}

# eks.tf
module "eks" {
  source          = "terraform-aws-modules/eks/aws"
  version         = "~> 19.0"
  cluster_name    = "${var.project_name}-eks"
  cluster_version = "1.28"
  vpc_id          = aws_vpc.main.id
  subnet_ids      = aws_subnet.private[*].id

  eks_managed_node_groups = {
    default = {
      min_size       = 3
      max_size       = 20
      desired_size   = 3
      instance_types = ["t3.large", "t3a.large"]
    }
    memory_optimized = {
      min_size       = 1
      max_size       = 10
      desired_size   = 1
      instance_types = ["r6g.large"]
      taints = [{ key = "workload", value = "memory", effect = "NoSchedule" }]
    }
  }
}

```

## 19.4 Estrategias de Despliegue

La siguiente tabla compara las estrategias de despliegue disponibles y su aplicabilidad por modulo:

| Estrategia           | Descripcion                                                                  | Tiempo de Downtime | Rollback                    | Riesgo | Modulos Aplicables       |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | --------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------ |
| Rolling Update       | Actualiza pods gradualmente, manteniendo viejos hasta que nuevos esten ready | Cero               | Automatico (maxUnavailable) | Bajo   | Todos los modulos        |
| Blue-Green           | Dos entornos completos, switch instantaneo via LB                            | Cero               | Switch LB a blue            | Bajo   | API, Auth, Core          |
| Canary               | Despliega nueva version a % pequeno de trafico, monitorea, expande           | Cero               | Redirigir trafico           | Medio  | API, Workflows, Reportes |
| A/B Testing          | Despliegue basado en flags de feature con segmentacion de usuarios           | Cero               | Deshabilitar flag           | Medio  | UI, Notificaciones       |
| Shadow               | Ejecuta nueva version en paralelo sin trafico real                           | Cero               | Eliminar instancia shadow   | Bajo   | Reportes, Analytics      |
| Feature Flags        | Activacion controlada de nuevas funcionalidades                              | Cero               | Desactivar flag             | Bajo   | Todos los modulos        |
| Progressive Delivery | Combinacion de canary + feature flags + session affinity                     | Cero               | Multi-layer                 | Bajo   | Modulos criticos         |

## Configuracion de Despliegue por Modulo — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de configuracion de despliegue por modulo. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

### 19.4.1 Configuracion de Despliegue: Core Application Service

| Parametro                | Valor                                   | Justificacion                                          |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| Estrategia Primaria      | Blue-Green                              | Modulos criticos requieren switch instantaneo          |
| Max Surge                | 100%                                    | Capacidad de absorcion durante deploy                  |
| Max Unavailable          | 0                                       | Zero downtime garantizado                              |
| Progress Deadline        | 600s                                    | Timeout para espera de progreso                        |
| Revision History Limit   | 10                                      | Revisiones mantenidas para rollback                    |
| Min Ready Seconds        | 30                                      | Tiempo minimo antes de marcar como ready               |
| Termination Grace Period | 30s                                     | Tiempo para finalizar conexiones existentes            |
| PreStop Hook             | sleep 5                                 | Espera antes de recibir SIGTERM para deregistro del LB |
| PostStart Hook           | /health-check.sh                        | Verificacion post-inicio del contenedor                |
| Deployment Priority      | P0 - Critico                            | Orden de despliegue en pipelines                       |
| Health Check Path        | /api/health/ready                       | Endpoint de readiness probe                            |
| Health Check Interval    | 10s                                     | Frecuencia de verificacion de salud                    |
| Topology Spread          | topology.kubernetes.io/zone: max-skew=1 | Distribucion uniforme entre zonas de disponibilidad    |
| PDB Min Available        | 2                                       | Pods minimos durante maintenance                       |

Manifiesto de despliegue especifico para Core Application Service:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: mod-01-service
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app: sw-aoe
    component: mod-01
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: BlueGreen
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 100%
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      component: mod-01
  template:
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    component: mod-01
                topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone

```

# 20. Arquitectura de Seguridad Profunda

Esta seccion describe la arquitectura de seguridad en profundidad del sistema **SW-AOE**, implementando un modelo Zero Trust con Defense in Depth.

## 20.1 Modelo Zero Trust Architecture

El sistema implementa los 5 pilares de Zero Trust segun NIST SP 800-207:

| Pilar       | Implementacion                                          | Controles                                      | Verificacion                          |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Identity    | OIDC con NextAuth.js v5 + MFA TOTP/FIDO2                | SSO, Passwordless, JIT provisioning            | Continuous authentication every 15min |
| Device      | Device posture check via mTLS certificates              | Certificate pinning, device attestation        | Re-evaluation cada sesion             |
| Network     | Microsegmentacion con Network Policies de K8s           | Allow-list, egress filtering, DNS policies     | Real-time flow logs                   |
| Application | RBAC + ABAC con Policy Engine (OPA/Cedar)               | Fine-grained permissions, attribute-based      | Every request evaluated               |
| Data        | Encryption at rest (AES-256-GCM) + in transit (TLS 1.3) | Key rotation (90 days), field-level encryption | Continuous integrity checks           |

## 20.2 Configuracion mTLS

```yaml
# cert-manager ClusterIssuer para mTLS
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: ClusterIssuer
metadata:
  name: mtls-issuer
spec:
  selfSigned: {}
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: server-cert
  namespace: production
spec:
  secretName: server-tls
  duration: 8760h  # 1 year
  renewBefore: 720h  # 30 days
  issuerRef:
    name: mtls-issuer
    kind: ClusterIssuer
  dnsNames:
    - sw-aoe.internal
  ipAddresses:
    - 10.0.0.0/8

```

## 20.3 Secrets Management

| Componente             | Secret Backend           | Rotacion | Acceso                     | Audit           |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------ | -------- | -------------------------- | --------------- |
| Database credentials   | HashiCorp Vault          | 90 dias  | App ServiceAccount via CSI | Vault audit log |
| API Keys (third-party) | AWS Secrets Manager      | 30 dias  | Lambda rotation function   | CloudTrail      |
| TLS Certificates       | cert-manager + Vault PKI | 90 dias  | auto-renewal               | Vault audit     |
| JWT Signing Key        | Vault Transit            | 180 dias | App via transit API        | Vault audit     |
| Encryption Keys (DEK)  | AWS KMS                  | 365 dias | Envelope encryption        | CloudTrail      |
| OAuth Client Secrets   | Vault KV v2              | 90 dias  | App ServiceAccount         | Vault audit     |
| Webhook Secrets        | Vault KV v2              | 60 dias  | App via CSI provider       | Vault audit     |
| SMTP Credentials       | AWS Secrets Manager      | 90 dias  | Lambda rotation            | CloudTrail      |

## 20.4 WAF Rules Configuration

| Rule ID | Regla                   | Accion     | Severidad | Descripcion                                               |
| ------- | ----------------------- | ---------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| WAF-001 | SQL Injection Detection | BLOCK      | Critical  | Bloquea patrones de inyeccion SQL en todos los parametros |
| WAF-002 | XSS Prevention          | BLOCK      | Critical  | Detecta y bloquea scripts cross-site en input/output      |
| WAF-003 | Command Injection       | BLOCK      | Critical  | Previene ejecucion de comandos del sistema                |
| WAF-004 | Path Traversal          | BLOCK      | High      | Bloquea intentos de acceder a archivos del sistema        |
| WAF-005 | RFI/LFI Detection       | BLOCK      | High      | Previene inclusion de archivos remotos o locales          |
| WAF-006 | Rate Limiting           | RATE_LIMIT | Medium    | Maximo 100 requests/minuto por IP                         |
| WAF-007 | Geo-blocking            | BLOCK      | Medium    | Restringe acceso desde paises no autorizados              |
| WAF-008 | Bot Detection           | CHALLENGE  | Low       | CAPTCHA para trafico sospechoso                           |
| WAF-009 | Size Limit              | BLOCK      | Low       | Maximo 10MB por request body                              |
| WAF-010 | HTTP Method Restriction | BLOCK      | Medium    | Solo permite GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE                |
| WAF-011 | Content-Type Validation | BLOCK      | Medium    | Valida Content-Type en request/response                   |
| WAF-012 | Header Validation       | BLOCK      | Low       | Valida headers obligatorios (User-Agent, Accept)          |

## 20.5 DDoS Protection Layers

| Capa           | Proveedor                      | Threshold               | Mitigation                  | Escalation                 |
| -------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| L3/L4 Network  | Cloud Provider (AWS Shield)    | 10 Gbps / 1M pps        | Auto-mitigation via anycast | AWS DDoS Response Team     |
| L7 Application | CDN/WAF (CloudFlare/AWS WAF)   | 10K req/s               | Challenge page + rate limit | Security team notification |
| API Layer      | API Gateway                    | 1000 req/min per client | 429 Too Many Requests       | Auto-ban after 5 min       |
| Application    | Custom middleware              | Anomaly detection       | Request queueing            | Alert to on-call           |
| Database       | Connection pooling (PgBouncer) | Max 100 connections     | Query queueing              | Read replica promotion     |

## 20.6 SIEM Integration

| Source         | Log Type               | Destination                | Format  | Retention                |
| -------------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| Application    | Structured logs (Pino) | Elasticsearch via Logstash | JSON    | 90 dias hot, 1 year warm |
| Infrastructure | CloudTrail + K8s audit | Splunk Cloud               | JSON    | 1 year                   |
| Network        | VPC Flow Logs          | Elasticsearch              | Parquet | 30 dias                  |
| Security       | Vault audit + WAF logs | SIEM (Datadog Security)    | JSON    | 2 years                  |
| Database       | PostgreSQL audit log   | Elasticsearch              | CSV     | 1 year                   |
| Auth           | NextAuth.js events     | Elasticsearch              | JSON    | 1 year                   |

## Politicas de Seguridad por Modulo — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de politicas de seguridad por modulo. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

### 20.7.1 Politicas de Seguridad: Core Application Service

| Politica               | Configuracion                           | Justificacion                             |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| Network Policy         | Deny all ingress/egress, allow specific | Least privilege por defecto               |
| Pod Security Standard  | restricted                              | Proteccion contra escalada de privilegios |
| Resource Quotas        | CPU: 2 cores, Memory: 4Gi max           | Prevencion de resource exhaustion         |
| Limit Ranges           | Default: 100m CPU / 128Mi mem           | Garantizar recursos minimos               |
| Service Mesh mTLS      | STRICT mode                             | Cifrado obligatorio entre servicios       |

# 21. Arquitectura de Integracion

Esta seccion detalla la arquitectura de integracion del sistema **SW-AOE**, incluyendo patrones de API Gateway, arquitectura event-driven, service mesh y patrones de integracion empresarial.

## 21.1 API Gateway Configuration

| Feature            | Implementacion              | Configuracion                            | Modulos               |
| ------------------ | --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | --------------------- |
| Rate Limiting      | Token bucket algorithm      | 100 req/s per IP, 1000 req/s per API key | Todos                 |
| Authentication     | JWT validation + API key    | RS256 signature, 15min expiry            | Public endpoints      |
| Authorization      | OPA policy engine           | Rego policies per endpoint               | Todos                 |
| Request Validation | JSON Schema validation      | OpenAPI 3.1 spec enforcement             | Todos                 |
| CORS               | Origin whitelist            | Production: specific domains only        | Web endpoints         |
| Compression        | Brotli + Gzip               | Threshold: 1KB, level: 6                 | All responses         |
| Caching            | Redis-backed response cache | TTL: 60s for GET, bypass for auth        | Read-heavy endpoints  |
| Circuit Breaker    | Hystrix pattern             | 50% failure rate, 30s recovery           | Third-party calls     |
| Retry              | Exponential backoff         | 3 retries, 1s/2s/4s delay, jitter        | Idempotent operations |
| Timeout            | Per-route configuration     | Default: 30s, Streaming: 300s            | All routes            |
| Websocket          | WebSocket upgrade           | Heartbeat: 30s, max connections: 10K     | Real-time features    |
| gRPC Transcoding   | REST to gRPC                | HTTP/2 to gRPC proxy                     | Internal services     |
| Request ID         | UUID v7 header              | x-request-id propagated to all services  | All requests          |
| Logging            | Structured access logs      | Method, path, status, duration, user_id  | All requests          |
| Metrics            | Prometheus format           | request_count, request_duration, errors  | All routes            |

## 21.2 Event-Driven Architecture

La arquitectura event-driven se basa en los siguientes patrones y componentes:

| Patron             | Implementacion                    | Use Cases                               | Ordenamiento                  | Persistencia             |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| Event Notification | Redis Pub/Sub                     | Cache invalidation, real-time updates   | Sin orden garantizado         | Ephemeral                |
| Event Sourcing     | Apache Kafka (append-only log)    | Audit trail, temporal queries           | Estricto por particion        | 7 dias retention         |
| CQRS               | Separate read/write models        | Reportes, dashboards, queries complejas | Eventual consistency          | Projections en read DB   |
| Saga Pattern       | Orchestration via workflow engine | Transacciones multi-servicio            | Compensacion en caso de fallo | Saga state en DB         |
| Outbox Pattern     | PostgreSQL CDC (Debezium)         | Event publication confiable             | Igual al orden de commit      | Debezium offset tracking |
| Event Choreography | Kafka topics + consumer groups    | Workflows distribuidos sin orquestador  | Por topico                    | Kafka retention          |
| Dead Letter Queue  | Kafka DLQ topic                   | Eventos que fallan procesamiento        | N/A                           | 14 dias analisis         |
| Snapshot Pattern   | Periodic state snapshots          | Optimizacion de event replay            | Periodico (cada 100 eventos)  | Snapshot store           |

## 21.3 Service Mesh Configuration

| Feature            | Configuracion                   | Valor                                | Scope              |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------ |
| mTLS Mode          | STRICT                          | Todos los pods deben usar mTLS       | Namespace-wide     |
| Traffic Splitting  | Canary via Istio VirtualService | 90/10 split para canary              | Per deployment     |
| Circuit Breaker    | OutlierDetection                | 5 consecutive 5xx = ejection (30s)   | Per service        |
| Retry Policy       | Automatic retries               | 3 retries, 25ms interval             | Idempotent methods |
| Timeout            | Per-route                       | Default: 30s, gRPC: 10s              | All routes         |
| Rate Limiting      | Envoy rate limit filter         | 1000 req/min per service             | Per service        |
| Fault Injection    | For chaos testing               | 1% abort, 100ms delay (staging only) | Testing only       |
| Observability      | Automatic telemetry             | Prometheus metrics + Jaeger traces   | All traffic        |
| Access Control     | AuthorizationPolicy             | Namespace isolation                  | All services       |
| Header Propagation | x-request-id, x-b3-traceid      | Auto-propagated                      | All requests       |

# 22. Arquitectura de Datos

Esta seccion describe la arquitectura de datos avanzada del sistema **SW-AOE**.

## 22.1 CQRS Implementation

El sistema implementa el patron CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) para separar las operaciones de escritura de lectura:

| Componente        | Tecnologia                              | Proposito                                  | Consistencia                   | Escalabilidad                   |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| Write Store       | PostgreSQL 16                           | Transacciones ACID, source of truth        | Strong consistency             | Vertical scaling, read replicas |
| Read Store        | PostgreSQL 16 (replica) + Elasticsearch | Queries complejas, busquedas full-text     | Eventual consistency (< 500ms) | Horizontal scaling              |
| Event Bus         | Apache Kafka                            | Propagacion de cambios write -> read       | At least once delivery         | Partitioned by aggregate        |
| Projection Engine | Node.js worker + BullMQ                 | Procesamiento de eventos para proyecciones | Idempotent processing          | Job queue based                 |
| Cache Layer       | Redis Cluster                           | Cache de lecturas frecuentes               | TTL-based invalidation         | Horizontal scaling              |

## 22.2 Event Sourcing Schema

| Campo          | Tipo         | Descripcion                                | Index           |
| -------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------ | --------------- |
| event_id       | UUID v7      | Identificador unico del evento             | PRIMARY KEY     |
| aggregate_type | VARCHAR(100) | Tipo del aggregate (ej: User, Order)       | INDEX           |
| aggregate_id   | UUID         | ID del aggregate al que pertenece          | INDEX composite |
| event_type     | VARCHAR(100) | Tipo del evento (ej: UserCreated)          | INDEX           |
| event_data     | JSONB        | Payload del evento                         | GIN INDEX       |
| metadata       | JSONB        | Metadata (actor, ip, timestamp)            | -               |
| version        | BIGINT       | Version del aggregate                      | INDEX composite |
| created_at     | TIMESTAMPTZ  | Fecha/hora del evento                      | INDEX           |
| correlation_id | UUID         | ID de correlacion para distributed tracing | INDEX           |

## 22.3 ETL Pipeline Architecture

| Stage            | Herramienta          | Input                 | Output                   | Schedule       | Monitoring          |
| ---------------- | -------------------- | --------------------- | ------------------------ | -------------- | ------------------- |
| Extract          | Debezium CDC         | PostgreSQL WAL        | Kafka topics             | Real-time      | Lag monitoring      |
| Transform        | Apache Kafka Streams | Raw events            | Enriched events          | Real-time      | Consumer lag        |
| Load (Data Lake) | Spark on EMR         | Kafka + S3 raw        | S3 parquet (partitioned) | Hourly         | Job success/failure |
| Load (Warehouse) | dbt + PostgreSQL     | Data lake parquet     | Dimensional model        | Daily          | dbt test results    |
| Load (Search)    | Logstash pipeline    | PostgreSQL CDC        | Elasticsearch indices    | Near real-time | Index lag           |
| Orchestration    | Apache Airflow       | DAG definitions       | Scheduled pipelines      | Cron-based     | DAG status          |
| Quality Check    | Great Expectations   | Data warehouse tables | Validation results       | Post-load      | Expectation suite   |

## 22.4 Data Mesh Principles

El sistema sigue los principios de Data Mesh:

| Principio            | Implementacion                            | Responsable               | Herramienta                       |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| Domain Ownership     | Cada modulo es due~no de sus datos        | Equipo de dominio         | Data contracts en schema registry |
| Data as Product      | Cada modulo publica datasets documentados | Data product owner        | DataHub catalog                   |
| Self-Serve Platform  | Plataforma de datos self-service          | Platform team             | Airflow + dbt + Superset          |
| Federated Governance | Politicas globales + aplicacion local     | Data governance committee | Great Expectations + Atlas        |

# 23. Arquitectura de Escalabilidad

Esta seccion describe la arquitectura de escalabilidad del sistema **SW-AOE**.

## 23.1 Auto-Scaling Policies

| Recurso              | Metrica            | Target        | Min     | Max     | Scale Up           | Scale Down         |
| -------------------- | ------------------ | ------------- | ------- | ------- | ------------------ | ------------------ |
| App Server Pods      | CPU Utilization    | 70%           | 3       | 30      | 60s stabilization  | 300s stabilization |
| App Server Pods      | Memory Utilization | 80%           | 3       | 30      | 120s stabilization | 600s stabilization |
| App Server Pods      | Request Rate       | 1000 req/min  | 3       | 30      | 30s cooldown       | 300s cooldown      |
| Worker Pods          | Queue Depth        | 100 messages  | 1       | 20      | 30s cooldown       | 300s cooldown      |
| Worker Pods          | Job Duration P95   | 5s            | 1       | 20      | 60s evaluation     | 600s evaluation    |
| Database Connections | Active Connections | 80% of max    | 10      | 100     | PgBouncer scaling  | Connection cleanup |
| Redis Cluster        | Memory Usage       | 75%           | 3 nodes | 6 nodes | Manual + alerts    | N/A (manual)       |
| Kafka Partitions     | Consumer Lag       | 1000 messages | 6       | 24      | Manual evaluation  | N/A                |

## 23.2 Sharding Strategy

| Entidad  | Shard Key       | Algoritmo               | Shards  | Distribution              | Hotspot Mitigation                  |
| -------- | --------------- | ----------------------- | ------- | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Tenants  | tenant_id       | Hash modulo             | 16      | Uniforme por hash         | Rehashing con Consistent Hashing    |
| Users    | user_id         | Range-based por region  | 8       | Por region geografica     | Auto-split cuando shard > 100M rows |
| Events   | aggregate_id    | Hash + timestamp prefix | 24      | Por aggregate + tiempo    | Time-based compaction               |
| Sessions | session_id hash | Consistent hashing      | 6       | Ring distribution         | Virtual nodes (150 per shard)       |
| Files    | file_id         | Content-hash based      | Dynamic | Uniforme por content hash | Balanced by hash distribution       |

## 23.3 Caching Architecture

| Capa             | Tecnologia             | TTL      | Invalidation            | Hit Rate Target | Max Size     |
| ---------------- | ---------------------- | -------- | ----------------------- | --------------- | ------------ |
| L1 - Application | In-process Map (LRU)   | 5s       | Time-based              | 80%             | 1000 entries |
| L2 - Distributed | Redis Cluster          | 60s - 1h | Write-through + pub/sub | 95%             | 64GB total   |
| L3 - CDN         | CloudFlare / Fastly    | 1h - 24h | Purge API + tags        | 99%             | Unlimited    |
| L4 - Database    | PostgreSQL buffer pool | Auto     | LRU eviction            | 95%             | 75% of RAM   |

## 23.4 CDN Configuration

| Setting                        | Value             | Scope                  | Justificacion                  |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Cache-Control: public, max-age | 31536000          | Static assets (hashed) | Immutable con cache busting    |
| Cache-Control: s-maxage        | 3600              | API GET responses      | 1h CDN cache                   |
| Cache-Control: no-cache        | -                 | Auth endpoints         | Nunca cachear auth             |
| Stale-While-Revalidate         | 86400             | Static assets          | Sirve stale mientras revalida  |
| Vary                           | Accept-Encoding   | All responses          | Separate cache por encoding    |
| Surrogate-Key                  | Per-module key    | API responses          | Invalidacion granular          |
| Edge Functions                 | Geo-redirect, A/B | Specific routes        | Logica en edge sin origin call |
