# 29. Resiliencia y Tolerancia a Fallos

Esta seccion define la estrategia integral de resiliencia del sistema **SW-AOE**, incluyendo patrones de retry, timeout, circuit breaker, bulkhead, fallback, y escenarios de fallo con sus respectivos planes de recuperacion.

## 29.1 Politicas de Retry Globales

| Politica            | Max Retries | Delay Inicial | Backoff          | Jitter           | Solo Idempotente         | Timeout Total |
| ------------------- | ----------- | ------------- | ---------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------ | ------------- |
| Database Transient  | 3           | 500ms         | Exponential (2x) | Full (+/- 100ms) | Si                       | 10s           |
| Redis Connection    | 2           | 200ms         | Exponential (2x) | Full (+/- 50ms)  | Si                       | 2s            |
| Kafka Producer      | 3           | 1s            | Exponential (2x) | Full (+/- 200ms) | Si                       | 15s           |
| External API (GET)  | 3           | 1s            | Exponential (2x) | Decorrelated     | Si                       | 30s           |
| External API (POST) | 1           | 2s            | Fixed            | None             | Requiere idempotency key | 10s           |
| WebSocket Reconnect | 5           | 1s            | Linear (+1s)     | Full (+/- 500ms) | N/A                      | 30s           |
| DNS Resolution      | 2           | 100ms         | Fixed            | None             | Si                       | 1s            |
| File Storage Upload | 3           | 2s            | Exponential (2x) | Full (+/- 500ms) | Requiere checksum        | 60s           |
| Email Delivery      | 3           | 5s            | Exponential (3x) | Decorrelated     | N/A (async)              | 120s          |
| Search Indexing     | 5           | 500ms         | Exponential (2x) | Full (+/- 100ms) | Si                       | 60s           |

## 29.2 Configuracion de Circuit Breaker

| Circuito         | Failure Threshold | Success Threshold | Open Duration | Half-Open Max | Sliding Window | Monitored Errors                            |
| ---------------- | ----------------- | ----------------- | ------------- | ------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| Database Primary | 5 en 60s          | 3 consecutivos    | 30s           | 3 requests    | 60s rolling    | Connection timeout, Query timeout, Deadlock |
| Database Replica | 10 en 60s         | 2 consecutivos    | 15s           | 5 requests    | 60s rolling    | Connection timeout, Replication lag         |
| Redis Cluster    | 5 en 30s          | 2 consecutivos    | 10s           | 3 requests    | 30s rolling    | Connection timeout, CLUSTERDOWN             |
| Kafka Producer   | 3 en 30s          | 2 consecutivos    | 20s           | 2 requests    | 30s rolling    | Leader not available, Buffer full           |
| Kafka Consumer   | 5 en 60s          | 3 consecutivos    | 30s           | 5 requests    | 60s rolling    | Deserialization error, Poison pill          |
| External API A   | 10 en 120s        | 3 consecutivos    | 60s           | 3 requests    | 120s rolling   | 5xx, Timeout, Network error                 |
| External API B   | 5 en 60s          | 2 consecutivos    | 30s           | 2 requests    | 60s rolling    | 429, 5xx, Timeout                           |
| Email Service    | 3 en 60s          | 1 consecutivo     | 120s          | 1 request     | 120s rolling   | Auth error, Rate limit, Timeout             |
| File Storage     | 5 en 120s         | 2 consecutivos    | 60s           | 3 requests    | 120s rolling   | Auth error, Timeout, Quota                  |
| Search Engine    | 5 en 60s          | 2 consecutivos    | 30s           | 3 requests    | 60s rolling    | Connection error, Index missing, Timeout    |

## 29.3 Politicas de Bulkhead Globales

| Bulkhead ID     | Tipo           | Resource Type            | Max Concurrent | Queue Size | Timeout Queue | Reject Policy      | Monitoring          |
| --------------- | -------------- | ------------------------ | -------------- | ---------- | ------------- | ------------------ | ------------------- |
| BH-001-DB       | ThreadPool     | Database connections     | 50             | 100        | 10s           | HTTP 503           | Pool gauge metric   |
| BH-002-REDIS    | Semaphore      | Redis operations         | 100            | 0          | 100ms         | Fallback local     | Semaphore counter   |
| BH-003-HTTP-INT | ThreadPool     | Internal HTTP calls      | 30             | 50         | 30s           | Circuit breaker    | Thread count metric |
| BH-004-HTTP-EXT | ThreadPool     | External HTTP calls      | 10             | 20         | 60s           | Fallback response  | Thread count metric |
| BH-005-KAFKA    | BufferQueue    | Kafka produce operations | 1000           | 5000       | 5s            | DB outbox fallback | Queue depth metric  |
| BH-006-WORKERS  | ProcessPool    | Background job workers   | 8              | 200        | 300s          | DLQ + alert        | Worker count metric |
| BH-007-WS       | ConnectionPool | WebSocket connections    | 10000          | 0          | N/A           | Reject new WS      | Connection counter  |
| BH-008-SEARCH   | Semaphore      | Search operations        | 20             | 50         | 15s           | DB fallback query  | Semaphore counter   |
| BH-009-EMAIL    | RateLimiter    | Email sending            | 100/min        | 500        | 3600s         | Queue + retry      | Rate counter        |
| BH-010-FILE     | ThreadPool     | File upload/download     | 20             | 100        | 120s          | Error to client    | Thread count metric |

## 29.4 Configuracion de Timeout por Capa

| Capa                     | Timeout Connect | Timeout Read | Timeout Write | Timeout Total | Idle Timeout | Keep-Alive |
| ------------------------ | --------------- | ------------ | ------------- | ------------- | ------------ | ---------- |
| Client -> API Gateway    | 5s              | 30s          | 30s           | 60s           | 120s         | 30s        |
| API Gateway -> App       | 2s              | 25s          | 25s           | 30s           | 60s          | 30s        |
| App -> PostgreSQL        | 2s              | 10s          | 10s           | 15s           | 30s          | 30s        |
| App -> Redis             | 1s              | 100ms        | 100ms         | 500ms         | 60s          | 30s        |
| App -> Kafka             | 5s              | 30s          | 30s           | 60s           | N/A          | N/A        |
| App -> External API      | 5s              | 15s          | 15s           | 30s           | 30s          | 15s        |
| App -> File Storage      | 5s              | 60s          | 60s           | 120s          | 30s          | 30s        |
| App -> Search Engine     | 2s              | 10s          | 5s            | 15s           | 30s          | 30s        |
| App -> Email Service     | 5s              | 30s          | 30s           | 60s           | 30s          | 15s        |
| Worker -> App (internal) | 1s              | 60s          | 30s           | 120s          | N/A          | N/A        |

## 29.5 Procedimientos de Recovery Automatico

| Escenario             | Detection Method      | Auto-Recovery Action          | Max Time to Recover | Human Escalation      | Post-Recovery Validation    |
| --------------------- | --------------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------- | --------------------- | --------------------------- |
| Database primary down | Health check fail x3  | Promote replica + update DNS  | 5 minutos           | DBA si > 5min         | Write + read verification   |
| Redis cluster down    | PING timeout          | Restart Redis nodes           | 2 minutos           | DevOps si > 2min      | Cache warmup + verification |
| Kafka broker down     | Producer send fail    | Restart broker + rebalance    | 5 minutos           | SRE si > 5min         | Consumer lag check          |
| App server OOM        | Process exit signal   | Kubernetes restart pod        | 1 minuto            | DevOps si > 3 crashes | Health check + smoke test   |
| Disk space full       | Alert at 90%          | Log rotation + temp cleanup   | 2 minutos           | DevOps si > 95%       | Disk usage check            |
| Memory leak           | Heap > 85% threshold  | Rolling restart pods          | 5 minutos           | SRE si > 15min        | Heap monitoring 10min       |
| Network partition     | Heartbeat timeout     | Quorum-based isolation        | 30 minutos          | Network team          | Connectivity verification   |
| Certificate expired   | TLS handshake fail    | Auto-renewal via cert-manager | 5 minutos           | DevOps si auto fails  | HTTPS connection test       |
| Configuration drift   | Drift detection agent | Reconcile to desired state    | 5 minutos           | Platform team         | Config checksum verify      |
| Zombie process        | Process monitor       | SIGKILL + restart             | 1 minuto            | DevOps si recurrente  | Process health check        |

## 29.6 Estrategias de Fallback y Degradacion Graceful

| Componente Fallido | Nivel Degradacion | Comportamiento Fallback                    | Impacto en Usuario                 | Auto-Recovery       | Notificacion   |
| ------------------ | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- | ------------------- | -------------- |
| Database Primary   | Critico (P0)      | Read-only replica mode + maintenance page  | No puede escribir datos            | Manual con DBA      | PagerDuty P1   |
| Database Replica   | Parcial (P2)      | Reads van a primary, latencia incrementada | Mas lento pero funcional           | Auto (30s)          | Slack alert    |
| Redis Cache        | Parcial (P2)      | In-memory LRU local, no distributed cache  | Ligeramente mas lento              | Auto (10s)          | Slack warning  |
| Kafka (Producer)   | Parcial (P2)      | Outbox pattern + retry en DB               | Eventos en cola temporal           | Auto (60s)          | Slack alert    |
| Kafka (Consumer)   | Parcial (P2)      | Events acumulan, procesamiento reanuda     | Datos eventualmente consistentes   | Auto (30s)          | Slack alert    |
| External API A     | Degradado (P1)    | Cached response (stale) + retry async      | Datos ligeramente desactualizados  | Auto (60s)          | Slack alert    |
| External API B     | Degradado (P1)    | Circuit open + fallback response           | Feature parcialmente deshabilitada | Auto (30s)          | Slack warning  |
| Email Service      | Degradado (P1)    | Queue en DB + reenvio cuando recupere      | Emails retrasados                  | Auto (120s)         | Slack alert    |
| File Storage       | Degradado (P1)    | Local temp storage + sync deferred         | Uploads fallan temporalmente       | Auto (60s)          | Slack alert    |
| Search Engine      | Degradado (P1)    | DB fallback queries (mas lento)            | Busquedas mas lentas               | Auto (30s)          | Slack warning  |
| CDN / Edge         | Minimo (P3)       | Origin serve directo (sin cache)           | Ligeramente mas lento global       | Auto (CDN failover) | Log only       |
| Monitoring Stack   | N/A               | Logs locales persistentes como backup      | No afecta usuario                  | Auto (manual fix)   | Email a DevOps |

## Resiliencia y Tolerancia a Fallos — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de resiliencia y tolerancia a fallos. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

### 29.5.1 Resiliencia: Core Application Service

El modulo **Core Application Service** (MOD-01) implementa las siguientes estrategias de resiliencia y tolerancia a fallos, adaptadas a sus patrones de comunicacion y dependencias:

#### 29.5.1.1 Escenarios de Fallo y Respuesta — Core Application Service

| ID Escenario | Descripcion del Fallo           | Probabilidad     | Impacto | Deteccion                | Respuesta Automatica           | Fallback                   | Recovery Manual            | Tiempo Estimado |
| ------------ | ------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------ | -------------------------- | -------------------------- | --------------- |
| MOD-01-F01   | Caida de base de datos primaria | Baja (0.1%)      | Critico | Health check fail 3x     | Switch a read-only replica     | Maintenance page           | Promote replica + SRE      | 5-30 min        |
| MOD-01-F02   | Replica de BD con lag excesivo  | Media (2%)       | Medio   | Replication lag > 5s     | Redirect reads a primary       | Primary reads only         | Investigar lag cause       | 5-15 min        |
| MOD-01-F03   | Perdida de conexion Redis       | Media (3%)       | Medio   | PING timeout             | Circuit breaker -> local cache | LRU in-memory              | Reconnect Redis            | 10-30s          |
| MOD-01-F04   | Kafka broker unavailable        | Baja (0.5%)      | Medio   | Producer send fail       | Outbox pattern + DB queue      | DB outbox table            | Restart Kafka broker       | 1-5 min         |
| MOD-01-F05   | Kafka consumer crash            | Media (1%)       | Bajo    | Consumer lag > threshold | Auto-restart consumer          | Reprocess desde offset     | Manual offset reset        | 1-10 min        |
| MOD-01-F06   | External API timeout            | Media (5%)       | Medio   | Request timeout 30s      | Retry con backoff + fallback   | Cached stale data          | Verificar servicio externo | 30s - 5min      |
| MOD-01-F07   | External API rate limit         | Alta (10%)       | Bajo    | HTTP 429 response        | Circuit open + wait + retry    | Throttle internal requests | Contactar proveedor        | Variable        |
| MOD-01-F08   | Memory leak gradual             | Baja (1%)        | Alto    | Memory > 80% limit       | Auto-restart container         | Graceful drain + restart   | Analizar heap dump         | 1-5 min         |
| MOD-01-F09   | CPU spike por query pesada      | Media (3%)       | Medio   | CPU > 90% por 3 min      | Query timeout + kill           | Cached response            | Optimize query             | 1-10 min        |
| MOD-01-F10   | DNS resolution failure          | Muy baja (0.1%)  | Critico | NXDOMAIN / timeout       | DNS cache fallback             | Static hosts file          | Flush DNS + retry          | 1-5 min         |
| MOD-01-F11   | SSL certificate expiry          | Muy baja (0.01%) | Critico | TLS handshake fail       | Auto-renewal via cert-manager  | Self-signed temporal       | Manual cert rotation       | 5-30 min        |
| MOD-01-F12   | Data corruption en BD           | Muy baja (0.01%) | Critico | Checksum mismatch        | Alert + block writes           | Restore from backup        | DBA investigation          | 30 min - 2h     |
| MOD-01-F13   | Stale cache serving wrong data  | Media (2%)       | Medio   | Business rule validation | Cache invalidation + reload    | Query source of truth      | Purge cache manual         | 1-5 min         |
| MOD-01-F14   | Worker queue bottleneck         | Media (5%)       | Medio   | Queue depth > 10000      | Auto-scale workers             | Reject new jobs            | Increase capacity          | 5-15 min        |
| MOD-01-F15   | Disk space exhaustion           | Baja (1%)        | Alto    | Disk > 90% used          | Log rotation + cleanup         | Delete old logs/temp       | Expand volume              | 5-30 min        |
| MOD-01-F16   | Network partition (split brain) | Muy baja (0.05%) | Critico | Heartbeat timeout        | Quorum-based leader election   | Read-only mode             | Network team               | 5-60 min        |
| MOD-01-F17   | Deployment failure partial      | Media (5%)       | Medio   | Health check post-deploy | Automatic rollback             | Previous version           | Manual investigation       | 5-15 min        |
| MOD-01-F18   | Zombie connections en pool      | Media (3%)       | Medio   | Pool exhaustion          | Pool purge + recreate          | New connections            | Investigate leak source    | 1-5 min         |

| MOD-04-F14   | Worker queue bottleneck         | Media (5%)       | Medio   | Queue depth > 10000      | Auto-scale workers             | Reject new jobs            | Increase capacity          | 5-15 min        |

# 30. Estrategias de Versionado de APIs

Esta seccion describe las estrategias de versionado de APIs del sistema **SW-AOE**, incluyendo la evolucion planeada de v1 a v3, politicas de deprecacion, migracion de clientes y mantenimiento de compatibilidad backward.

## 30.1 Politica de Versionado Global

| Aspecto                | Politica                                  | Implementacion                    | Ejemplo                                 |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| Schema de Versionado   | URL Path Versioning                       | /api/v{major}/resource            | /api/v1/users, /api/v2/users            |
| Versiones Simultaneas  | Max 3 (current + 1 deprecated + 1 legacy) | Routing en API Gateway            | v1, v2, v3 al mismo tiempo              |
| Deprecation Notice     | HTTP header + Sunset header               | Deprecation: true, Sunset: <date> | Response headers en v1 deprecated       |
| Lifetime de Version    | Minimo 18 meses desde GA                  | Calendar en ADR                   | v1: Jan 2025 - Jun 2026                 |
| Breaking Change Policy | Solo en nueva version major               | Semantic Versioning               | v1 -> v2 = breaking changes OK          |
| Migration Guide        | Documento + script automatico             | Wiki + migration CLI              | npm run migrate-api-v1-to-v2            |
| Sunset Period          | 6 meses tras deprecation                  | HTTP Sunset header                | v1 deprecated Ene 2026, sunset Jun 2026 |
| Emergency Patch        | Minor version (patch)                     | v1.0.1, no breaking changes       | Security fix sin API change             |

## 30.2 Evolucion de Versiones Planeada

| Version | Estado   | Fecha GA   | Fecha Sunset | Cambios Clave                                           | Clientes Afectados      | Migracion Requerida |
| ------- | -------- | ---------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------- |
| v1      | Estable  | 2025-01-15 | 2026-07-01   | API base CRUD, auth basica, endpoints core              | Todos (version inicial) | Si -> v2            |
| v2      | Beta     | 2025-07-01 | 2027-01-01   | Paginacion cursor-based, filtros avanzados,_bulk ops    | Todos los activos       | Recomendada         |
| v3      | Planning | 2026-01-01 | 2027-07-01   | GraphQL overlay, real-time subscriptions, fields sparse | Solo nuevos clientes    | Opcional            |

## 30.3 Contrato de Versionado de Headers HTTP

| Header                    | Presente en                   | Valor Ejemplo                        | Proposito                               | Cacheable | Estandar       |
| ------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------- | --------- | -------------- |
| API-Version               | Todas las respuestas          | v2                                   | Version de la API que respondio         | No        | Custom         |
| Deprecation               | Endpoints deprecated          | true                                 | Indica que el endpoint esta deprecated  | No        | Custom         |
| Sunset                    | Endpoints con fecha de retiro | Sat, 01 Jun 2026 00:00:00 GMT        | Fecha en que el endpoint sera removido  | Si        | RFC 8594       |
| X-Request-ID              | Todas las respuestas          | req-uuid-v7                          | ID unico para rastreo de request        | No        | Custom         |
| X-RateLimit-Limit         | Todas las respuestas          | 100                                  | Limite de requests por ventana          | No        | Draft standard |
| X-RateLimit-Remaining     | Todas las respuestas          | 95                                   | Requests restantes en la ventana        | No        | Draft standard |
| X-RateLimit-Reset         | Todas las respuestas          | 1700000000                           | Timestamp cuando se resetea el contador | No        | Draft standard |
| Retry-After               | Respuestas 429                | 60                                   | Segundos antes de reintentar            | No        | RFC 7231       |
| Content-Type              | Todas las respuestas          | application/json; charset=utf-8      | Formato del body                        | Si        | RFC 7231       |
| Cache-Control             | Respuestas cacheables         | public, max-age=60                   | Politica de cache                       | Si        | RFC 7234       |
| Link                      | Paginated responses           | <https://...?cursor=abc>; rel="next" | Links de paginacion HATEOAS             | Si        | RFC 8288       |
| Strict-Transport-Security | Todas las respuestas          | max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains  | Force HTTPS                             | Si        | RFC 6797       |

## 30.4 Matriz de Cambios entre Versiones

| Endpoint              | v1                      | v2 (Cambio)                   | v3 (Plan)                    | Breaking? | Migration Path             |
| --------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------- | --------- | -------------------------- |
| GET /resources        | Offset-based pagination | Cursor-based (after)          | Sparse fieldsets + filtering | Si        | Update pagination logic    |
| POST /resources       | Simple create           | Create + bulk option          | Batch with partial success   | No        | N/A                        |
| PUT /resources/:id    | Full update required    | Partial update (PATCH merged) | JSON Merge Patch             | No        | N/A                        |
| DELETE /resources/:id | Hard delete             | Soft delete by default        | Archive + retention policy   | Si        | Check deleted_at field     |
| GET /resources/search | Basic query params      | Advanced filtering DSL        | Full-text + faceted search   | Si        | New filter syntax          |
| Auth Header           | Authorization: Bearer   | Same + refresh token          | MFA token support            | No        | N/A                        |
| Error Format          | Custom JSON             | RFC 7807 Problem Details      | Same + error codes enum      | Si        | Update error parsing       |
| Rate Limit Headers    | No headers              | X-RateLimit-* headers         | Same + Retry-After           | No        | N/A                        |
| Response Envelope     | { data: ... }           | { data, meta, links }         | Same + included (sparse)     | Si        | Handle meta/links fields   |
| Webhooks              | N/A                     | POST on events                | Configurable webhooks        | N/A       | Register webhook endpoints |

### 2. MOD-02: Authentication Module

# 31. Arquitectura de Autorizacion Granular

Esta seccion describe el sistema de autorizacion granular del sistema **SW-AOE**, basado en un modelo RBAC + ABAC hybrid con permisos a nivel de recurso, accion, campo y condicion.

## 31.1 Modelo de Autorizacion

El sistema implementa un modelo de autorizacion de 4 capas:

| Capa                    | Modelo          | Descripcion                                   | Motor                   | Evaluacion   | Almacenamiento         |
| ----------------------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------ | ---------------------- |
| Capa 1: Autenticacion   | N/A             | Verificar identidad del usuario               | NextAuth.js + JWT       | Cada request | JWT claims             |
| Capa 2: Roles (RBAC)    | Role-Based      | Asignar roles agrupados (admin, user, viewer) | Custom middleware       | Cada request | PostgreSQL roles table |
| Capa 3: Permisos (ABAC) | Attribute-Based | Permisos granulares: recurso + accion         | OPA/Cedar Policy Engine | Cada request | OPA policies (Rego)    |
| Capa 4: Condiciones     | Context-Based   | Reglas condicionales (IP, hora, data owner)   | OPA conditions          | Cada request | OPA policies           |

## 31.2 Roles Predefinidos del Sistema

| Rol             | Descripcion                         | Permisos Base                      | Usuarios Tipicos     | Escalabilidad      | Jerarquia          |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------ | ------------------ |
| super_admin     | Acceso total sin restricciones      | ALL permissions                    | CTO, DevOps Lead     | Max 2 por sistema  | Superior a todos   |
| admin           | Administracion completa del sistema | ALL permissions (except system)    | Product Manager      | Max 5 por tenant   | Superior a manager |
| manager         | Gestion operativa de un dominio     | CRUD + approve + audit del dominio | Team Lead            | Max 10 por dominio | Superior a editor  |
| editor          | Creacion y edicion de recursos      | Create + Read + Update del dominio | Analyst, Senior Dev  | Ilimitado          | Superior a viewer  |
| viewer          | Solo lectura de recursos            | Read del dominio                   | Stakeholder, Auditor | Ilimitado          | Nivel mas bajo     |
| api_consumer    | Acceso via API key (terceros)       | Read + Write limitado via API      | External systems     | Por API key        | No tiene jerarquia |
| service_account | Acceso interno entre servicios      | Internal permissions only          | Backend services     | Por service        | No aplica          |

## 31.3 Modelo de Herencia de Permisos

| Rol Padre   | Rol Hijo     | Permisos Heredados           | Permisos Exclusivos       | Precedencia en Conflicto |
| ----------- | ------------ | ---------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| super_admin | admin        | Todos menos system-level     | N/A                       | super_admin siempre gana |
| admin       | manager      | CRUD + approve + audit       | admin-level settings      | admin > manager          |
| manager     | editor       | Create + Read + Update (own) | approve, reject, bulk ops | manager > editor         |
| editor      | viewer       | Read (all visible)           | Create + Update (own)     | editor > viewer          |
| viewer      | api_consumer | Read (own only)              | None                      | viewer > api_consumer    |

## 31.4 Condicionales de Autorizacion

| Condicion ID | Condicion           | Atributos Evaluados                       | Ejemplo                      | Combinable | Performance Impact  |
| ------------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------- |
| COND-001     | Ownership           | resource.ownerId == user.id               | Solo dueño puede editar      | Si         | Bajo (field lookup) |
| COND-002     | Department          | user.department == resource.department    | Mismo depto puede ver        | Si         | Bajo (field lookup) |
| COND-003     | IP Range            | request.ip in allowed_cidr_ranges         | Solo desde IPs autorizadas   | Si         | Bajo (IP parse)     |
| COND-004     | Time Window         | now() in [start_time, end_time]           | Ops criticas solo en horario | Si         | Nulo (time check)   |
| COND-005     | MFA Verified        | user.mfa_verified == true                 | Requiere MFA para acción     | Si         | Nulo (claim check)  |
| COND-006     | Resource Status     | resource.status in allowed_statuses       | Solo si recurso en estado X  | Si         | Bajo (field lookup) |
| COND-007     | Data Classification | resource.classification <= user.clearance | Clearance level check        | Si         | Bajo (comparison)   |
| COND-008     | Tenant Isolation    | resource.tenantId == user.tenantId        | Multi-tenant isolation       | Si         | Bajo (field lookup) |
| COND-009     | Concurrent Sessions | user.activeSessions <= maxSessions        | Limite de sesiones           | Si         | Medio (DB query)    |
| COND-010     | Geographic          | user.geoRegion in allowed_regions         | Restriccion por region       | Si         | Medio (geo-IP)      |

## 31.5 Estructura de Permisos

Cada permiso sigue el formato: `{recurso}:{accion}:{condicion}`. La siguiente tabla define todas las acciones disponibles:

| Accion  | Metodo HTTP     | Descripcion                 | Requiere Owner? | Auditable? | Bulk Allowed? | Condition Support |
| ------- | --------------- | --------------------------- | --------------- | ---------- | ------------- | ----------------- |
| create  | POST            | Crear nuevo recurso         | No              | Si         | Si            | Si                |
| read    | GET             | Leer recurso(s)             | No              | Si         | Si (list)     | Si                |
| update  | PUT/PATCH       | Modificar recurso existente | Si              | Si         | Si            | Si                |
| delete  | DELETE          | Eliminar recurso            | Si              | Si         | Si            | Si                |
| approve | POST            | Aprobar recurso pendiente   | No              | Si         | Si            | Si                |
| reject  | POST            | Rechazar recurso pendiente  | No              | Si         | Si            | Si                |
| archive | POST            | Archivar recurso            | Si              | Si         | Si            | Si                |
| export  | POST            | Exportar datos del recurso  | No              | Si         | Si            | Si                |
| admin   | POST/PUT/DELETE | Administracion del recurso  | No              | Si         | No            | Si                |
| grant   | POST            | Otorgar permisos a otros    | No              | Si         | Si            | Si                |
| audit   | GET             | Ver historial de auditoria  | No              | No (meta)  | Si            | Si                |

### 5. MOD-05: Search & Discovery Module

# 32. Plan de Pruebas de Arquitectura

Esta seccion define el plan de pruebas de arquitectura (Architecture Fitness Functions) para el sistema **SW-AOE**, verificando que las decisiones arquitectonicas se mantienen a lo largo del tiempo mediante tests automatizados.

## 32.1 Categorias de Architecture Fitness Functions

| Categoria         | Objetivo                                | Frecuencia  | Automatizacion        | Herramienta                 | Gate de Merge |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------- |
| Structure         | Verificar estructura de capas y modulos | Cada commit | CI pipeline           | Custom ESLint rules + Madge | Bloqueante    |
| Dependencies      | Detectar dependencias ciclicas          | Cada commit | CI pipeline           | Madge --circular            | Bloqueante    |
| API Contracts     | Validar OpenAPI spec vs implementacion  | Cada PR     | CI pipeline           | Prism + Schemathesis        | Bloqueante    |
| Security          | Verificar controles de seguridad        | Cada PR     | CI pipeline           | SAST (SonarQube) + DAST     | Bloqueante    |
| Performance       | Verificar budgets de rendimiento        | Cada deploy | CI pipeline + staging | k6 + Lighthouse CI          | Advertencia   |
| Compliance        | Verificar cumplimiento regulatorio      | Semanal     | Scheduled job         | Custom scripts + audit      | Advertencia   |
| Data Quality      | Validar integridad de datos             | Diario      | Cron job              | Great Expectations          | Alerta        |
| Chaos Engineering | Verificar resiliencia ante fallos       | Mensual     | Manual + automated    | Chaos Monkey + Litmus       | Informativo   |

## 32.2 Metricas de Quality Gates del Pipeline

| Gate              | Metrica                 | Threshold         | Accion si Falla              | Severidad         | Herramienta   | Override Posible       |
| ----------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------- | ----------------- | ------------- | ---------------------- |
| Lint              | ESLint errors           | 0 errors          | Bloquear merge               | Bloqueante        | ESLint 9      | No                     |
| Type Check        | TypeScript errors       | 0 errors          | Bloquear merge               | Bloqueante        | tsc --noEmit  | No                     |
| Unit Tests        | Test pass rate          | 100%              | Bloquear merge               | Bloqueante        | Vitest        | No                     |
| Unit Coverage     | Statement coverage      | >= 85%            | Advertir + bloquear si < 70% | Advertencia/Bloq. | c8 / istanbul | Si (con approval)      |
| Integration Tests | Test pass rate          | 100%              | Bloquear deploy              | Bloqueante        | Vitest        | No                     |
| E2E Tests         | Test pass rate          | 100%              | Bloquear deploy              | Bloqueante        | Playwright    | Si (con approval)      |
| Bundle Size       | JS bundle gzipped       | < 200KB           | Advertir si > 200KB          | Advertencia       | bundlesize    | Si                     |
| Security Scan     | SAST vulnerabilities    | 0 high/critical   | Bloquear deploy              | Bloqueante        | SonarQube     | No                     |
| Dependency Audit  | Vulnerable dependencies | 0 high/critical   | Bloquear merge               | Bloqueante        | npm audit     | Si (con approval)      |
| API Contract      | OpenAPI spec valid      | 100% coverage     | Advertir si < 100%           | Advertencia       | Schemathesis  | No                     |
| Dead Code         | Unused exports          | < 5%              | Advertir                     | Advertencia       | ts-prune      | Si                     |
| Complexity        | Max cyclomatic          | < 15 per function | Advertir si > 15             | Advertencia       | Lizard        | Si (con justification) |

| Load Balancer              | AWS ALB                | Application LB          | $22           | $264        | Auto-scale      | Fixed cost                |

# 34. Guia de Implementacion por Modulo

Esta seccion proporciona una guia de implementacion paso a paso para cada modulo del sistema **SW-AOE**, incluyendo configuracion de desarrollo, estructura de archivos, dependencias y procedimientos de testing.

## 34.1 Estructura Estandar de Modulo

Cada modulo sigue la estructura estandar basada en Domain-Driven Design y Clean Architecture:

| Directorio      | Proposito                         | Archivos Tipicos                       | Dependencias Permitidas | Tests                    |
| --------------- | --------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------ |
| domain/         | Logica de dominio pura            | entities, value-objects, events, rules | Solo shared/            | Unit tests               |
| application/    | Casos de uso y orquestacion       | services, DTOs, validators, interfaces | domain/                 | Unit + Integration       |
| infrastructure/ | Implementacion de infraestructura | repositories, adapters, clients        | application/            | Integration              |
| presentation/   | Endpoints y handlers HTTP         | controllers, routes, middleware        | application/            | E2E                      |
| __tests__/      | Tests del modulo                  | *.test.ts, *.spec.ts                   | Todos                   | Unit + Integration + E2E |
| types/          | Tipos TypeScript del modulo       | interfaces.ts, enums.ts                | domain/                 | Unit                     |
| migrations/     | Migraciones de BD del modulo      | *.sql, migration runner                | infrastructure/         | Integration              |
| docs/           | Documentacion del modulo          | README.md, ADRs, diagrams              | N/A                     | N/A                      |

## 34.2 Checklist de Pre-Implementacion

| Item                       | Descripcion                                | Responsable   | Verificacion       | Plantilla          | Duracion  |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------- | ------------------ | ------------------ | --------- |
| PRD del modulo             | Producto: requisitos del modulo definidos  | Product Owner | PRD review meeting | PRD template       | 2-4 horas |
| Analisis tecnico           | Tech Lead: viabilidad y complejidad        | Tech Lead     | Tech design doc    | Architecture doc   | 2-3 horas |
| Dependencias identificadas | Lista de modulos y servicios dependientes  | Tech Lead     | Dependency matrix  | Jira tasks         | 1 hora    |
| API contract draft         | OpenAPI spec inicial del modulo            | Backend Lead  | Spec review        | OpenAPI template   | 1-2 horas |
| Data model draft           | Esquema de BD inicial del modulo           | Backend Lead  | Schema review      | Prisma template    | 1-2 horas |
| Security review prep       | Modelo de permisos y datos sensibles       | Security Lead | Security checklist | Security template  | 1 hora    |
| Test plan draft            | Estrategia de testing del modulo           | QA Lead       | Test plan doc      | Test plan template | 1-2 horas |
| Sprint planning            | Descomponer en tareas de sprint            | Scrum Master  | Sprint backlog     | Jira board         | 1 hora    |
| Environment setup          | Variables, secrets y configs preparados    | DevOps        | Env check script   | Config template    | 30 min    |
| Branch strategy            | Crear feature branch con naming convention | Developer     | Git branch exists  | Branch naming doc  | 5 min     |

## 34.3 Pipeline de Desarrollo por Modulo

| Etapa             | Accion                                         | Herramienta         | Gate                       | Automatico | Duracion Estimada |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------- | ---------- | ----------------- |
| 1. Setup          | Crear estructura de directorios del modulo     | CLI scaffold        | Estructura valida          | Si         | 2 min             |
| 2. Domain         | Definir entidades, eventos y reglas de dominio | TypeScript + Zod    | Tests unitarios pasan      | Si         | 2-4 horas         |
| 3. Application    | Implementar servicios y casos de uso           | TypeScript + DI     | Tests unitarios pasan      | Si         | 4-8 horas         |
| 4. Infrastructure | Implementar repositorios y adapters            | Prisma + clients    | Tests de integracion pasan | Si         | 2-4 horas         |
| 5. Presentation   | Implementar controladores y rutas              | Next.js API Routes  | Tests E2E pasan            | Si         | 2-4 horas         |
| 6. Documentation  | Escribir README, ADRs y diagrams               | Markdown + Mermaid  | Review aprobado            | No         | 1-2 horas         |
| 7. Code Review    | Revision de codigo por Tech Lead               | GitHub PR           | 2 approvals + CI green     | No         | 1-2 horas         |
| 8. QA Validation  | Pruebas manuales en staging                    | Playwright + manual | All checks pass            | Parcial    | 2-4 horas         |
| 9. Deploy         | Despliegue a produccion                        | CI/CD Pipeline      | Smoke tests pasan          | Si         | 5-15 min          |
| 10. Monitor       | Monitoreo post-deploy (48h)                    | Grafana + Sentry    | Sin alertas criticas       | Parcial    | 48 horas          |

## Guia de Implementacion por Modulo — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de guia de implementacion por modulo. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

### 34.3.1 Guia de Implementacion: Core Application Service

Guia paso a paso para implementar el modulo **Core Application Service** (MOD-01) desde cero hasta produccion:

#### 34.3.1.1 Pasos de Configuracion Inicial — Core Application Service

# 35. Glosario y Referencias Arquitectonicas

Esta seccion proporciona un glosario completo de terminos arquitectonicos utilizados a lo largo de este documento, asi como las referencias a estandares, frameworks y mejores practicas mencionadas en el sistema **SW-AOE**.

## 35.1 Glosario de Patrones de Diseno

| Termino                      | Definicion                                                        | Seccion de Referencia | Estandar / Fuente                      | Uso en el Sistema                                  |
| ---------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- | -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| Circuit Breaker              | Patron que previene llamadas a servicios que probablemente fallen | 29.2, 29.3            | Microsoft Patterns                     | Proteccion de llamadas a APIs externas y BD        |
| Bulkhead                     | Aislamiento de recursos para que un fallo no propague             | 29.3                  | Microsoft Patterns                     | Thread pools separados por tipo de operacion       |
| Retry con Backoff            | Reintentar operaciones fallidas con delays crecientes             | 29.1                  | AWS Well-Architected                   | Reintentos en BD, Redis, Kafka y APIs externas     |
| CQRS                         | Separacion de lecturas y escrituras en modelos diferentes         | 27.1, 27.5            | Martin Fowler                          | Eventos de dominio con proyecciones de lectura     |
| Event Sourcing               | Almacenar estado como secuencia de eventos inmutables             | 27.1, 27.5            | Martin Fowler                          | Audit trail y reconstruccion temporal              |
| Saga Pattern                 | Transacciones distribuidas con compensacion                       | 27.1                  | Microservices Patterns (C. Richardson) | Orquestacion de workflows multi-modulo             |
| Outbox Pattern               | Publicacion confiable de eventos desde BD transaccional           | 27.1, 29.6            | Microservices Patterns                 | Eventos publicados atomicamente con cambios de BD  |
| Sidecar Proxy                | Proxy auxiliar desplegado junto al servicio principal             | 27.1                  | Service Mesh Patterns                  | Envoy sidecar para mTLS y observabilidad           |
| API Gateway                  | Punto de entrada unificado para todas las APIs                    | 27.2, 30.1            | Microservices Patterns                 | Routing, auth, rate limiting centralizado          |
| Backpressure                 | Control de flujo para evitar sobrecarga del consumidor            | 27.4                  | Reactive Streams                       | Semaphores, thread pools, rate limiting            |
| Service Mesh                 | Infraestructura de red para comunicacion entre servicios          | 27.2                  | Istio / Envoy                          | mTLS, circuit breaker, observabilidad transparente |
| Feature Flag                 | Toggle de funcionalidades sin redeploy                            | 28.3, 28.4            | LaunchDarkly / Unleash                 | Rollout gradual, A/B testing, kill switch          |
| Blue-Green Deploy            | Dos entornos identicos con switch instantaneo                     | 27.1                  | Deployment Patterns                    | Zero downtime deployment para modulos criticos     |
| Canary Release               | Despliegue progresivo a porcentaje de trafico                     | 27.1                  | Deployment Patterns                    | Validacion gradual de nuevas versiones             |
| Graceful Degradation         | Reduccion controlada de funcionalidad ante fallos                 | 29.6                  | Stability Patterns                     | Cached responses, fallback a BD, modo read-only    |
| Health Check                 | Verificacion periodica de disponibilidad del servicio             | 29.5, 29.6            | Kubernetes Probes                      | Liveness, readiness, startup probes                |
| Rate Limiting                | Control de frecuencia de solicitudes por cliente                  | 27.4, 28.2            | Cloud Design Patterns                  | Sliding window, token bucket, fixed window         |
| Connection Pooling           | Reutilizacion de conexiones a BD                                  | 29.3                  | Database Patterns                      | PgBouncer para PostgreSQL                          |
| Sharding                     | Particion horizontal de datos                                     | 27.2                  | Database Scaling Patterns              | Distribucion por tenant_id o region                |
| CQRS Query Model             | Modelo de lectura optimizado para consultas                       | 27.5                  | CQRS Pattern                           | Proyecciones materializadas en Elasticsearch       |
| Fitness Function             | Test automatizado que verifica propiedad arquitectonica           | 32.1, 32.3            | Building Evolutionary Architectures    | Sin ciclos, coverage > 85%, bundle < 200KB         |
| Architecture Decision Record | Documento formal de decision arquitectonica                       | 1.5, 34.5             | Michael Nygard                         | ADR-001 a ADR-020 cubriendo todas las decisiones   |
| RBAC                         | Control de acceso basado en roles                                 | 31.2, 31.3            | NIST SP 800-162                        | super_admin, admin, manager, editor, viewer        |
| ABAC                         | Control de acceso basado en atributos                             | 31.1, 31.4            | NIST SP 800-162                        | Condiciones: ownership, department, IP, time, MFA  |
| mTLS                         | Mutual TLS para autenticacion bidireccional                       | 27.2                  | Service Mesh Security                  | Comunicacion entre servicios con certificados      |
| HATEOAS                      | Hypermedia como motor de estado de la aplicacion                  | 30.3, 30.4            | REST Maturity Model (RMM) Level 3      | Links en respuestas paginadas                      |

# 33. Catalogo de Patrones de Integracion

Este catalogo sirve como referencia para arquitectos y desarrolladores al disenar nuevas integraciones entre modulos del sistema y servicios externos.

## 33.2 Evaluacion de Patrones por Criterio de Seleccion

| Patron               | Acoplamiento | Escalabilidad | Mantenibilidad | Testabilidad | Latencia Max | Costo Infraestructura | Recomendado Para                            |
| -------------------- | ------------ | ------------- | -------------- | ------------ | ------------ | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| API REST Directa     | Alto         | Baja          | Alta           | Alta         | < 500ms      | Bajo                  | Integraciones simples, pocos servicios      |
| Event-Driven (Kafka) | Bajo         | Alta          | Media          | Media        | < 1s         | Alto                  | Flujos asincronos, alta escala              |
| gRPC Interno         | Medio        | Alta          | Alta           | Alta         | < 100ms      | Medio                 | Comunicacion interna de alto rendimiento    |
| GraphQL Federation   | Bajo         | Alta          | Media          | Alta         | < 500ms      | Medio                 | Frontend con necesidades de datos flexibles |
| WebSocket Real-time  | Alto         | Media         | Media          | Baja         | < 100ms      | Medio                 | Notificaciones push, streaming de datos     |
| Batch ETL            | Bajo         | Alta          | Media          | Alta         | Horas        | Bajo                  | Reportes, data warehouse, migraciones       |

| REST API Gateway          | < 50ms     | < 200ms     | < 500ms     | < 0.1%            | 1000 req/s         | p95 > 500ms         | Prometheus + Grafana   |
| Event-Driven (Kafka)      | < 20ms     | < 100ms     | < 300ms     | < 0.01%           | 5000 events/s      | Consumer lag > 10K  | Kafka consumer metrics |
| gRPC Internal             | < 10ms     | < 50ms      | < 100ms     | < 0.05%           | 2000 req/s         | p95 > 100ms         | gRPC interceptors      |
| WebSocket Push            | < 30ms     | < 100ms     | < 200ms     | < 0.5%            | 1000 msgs/s        | Delivery delay > 1s | WS frame counter       |
| Batch ETL                 | N/A        | N/A         | < 2h total  | < 1%              | 100K rows/batch    | Job duration > 4h   | Airflow metrics        |
| Webhook Outbound          | < 200ms    | < 1s        | < 3s        | < 1%              | 100 deliveries/min | Failure rate > 5%   | Delivery dashboard     |
| CQRS Read Model           | < 50ms     | < 150ms     | < 300ms     | < 0.1%            | 500 req/s          | Staleness > 5s      | Event lag monitor      |
| Saga Orchestration        | N/A        | < 10s total | < 30s total | < 0.5%            | 100 sagas/min      | Saga duration > 60s | Saga state store       |
| Outbox Relay              | < 100ms    | < 500ms     | < 1s        | < 0.01%           | 2000 events/s      | Outbox depth > 1K   | Debezium metrics       |
| CDC (Change Data Capture) | < 50ms     | < 500ms     | < 2s        | < 0.01%           | 5000 changes/s     | CDC lag > 10s       | Debezium connector     |

## 33.4 Matriz de Seguridad por Patron de Integracion

| Patron       | Autenticacion         | Autorizacion             | Encriptacion en Transito | Encriptacion en Reposo | Validacion de Input     | Logging de Auditoria            |
| ------------ | --------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------ | ---------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| REST API     | JWT Bearer / OAuth2   | RBAC por endpoint        | TLS 1.3                  | N/A (stateless)        | Zod / Joi               | Request + Response logging      |
| Kafka Events | SASL/SSL              | ACL por topico           | TLS + SASL               | Encrypted at broker    | Avro schema validation  | Event log con consumer tracking |
| gRPC         | mTLS certificates     | Role-based gRPC metadata | mTLS                     | N/A                    | Protobuf schema         | Interceptor logging             |
| WebSocket    | JWT + session token   | Channel-level ACL        | WSS (TLS 1.3)            | N/A                    | JSON schema validation  | Connection + message logging    |
| Batch ETL    | Service account       | IP whitelist + role      | SSH / VPN                | AES-256 at rest        | Pre + post validation   | Job audit trail                 |
| Webhook      | HMAC-SHA256 signature | IP + secret validation   | HTTPS                    | N/A                    | Payload signature check | Delivery log con timestamps     |

# 34. Especificaciones de Navegacion y Routing

Esta seccion define las especificaciones completas de navegacion y routing para el sistema **SW-AOE**, incluyendo la estructura de rutas del frontend, middleware chains, guards de autenticacion y autorizacion, lazy loading strategies, meta tags SEO y metricas de rendimiento por ruta.

## 34.1 Arquitectura General de Routing

| Aspecto              | Estrategia                 | Implementacion                  | Justificacion                                             | Impacto en Performance     |
| -------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Framework de Routing | File-based routing         | Next.js App Router              | Convencion sobre configuracion, code splitting automatico | Lazy loading por ruta      |
| Layout Strategy      | Nested layouts por seccion | Layout components jerarquicos   | Reutilizacion de header/footer/sidebar                    | Shared components cache    |
| Code Splitting       | Automatic por ruta         | React.lazy + dynamic imports    | Reducir bundle inicial                                    | First Load JS reducido     |
| Prefetching          | Link prefetch on hover     | Next.js Link prefetch           | Navegacion instantanea                                    | Bandwidth extra previsible |
| Auth Guards          | Server-side + client-side  | Middleware.ts + useAuth hook    | Seguridad en doble capa                                   | Redirect < 100ms           |
| Role-based Routing   | Dynamic routes por rol     | Route config + role middleware  | Acceso granular por modulo                                | Evaluacion < 10ms          |
| Error Boundaries     | Por seccion y por ruta     | React ErrorBoundary + error.tsx | Contencion de errores                                     | No afecta rutas vecinas    |
| Loading States       | Skeleton + Suspense        | React.Suspense + loading.tsx    | UX fluida durante carga                                   | Perceived performance      |
| Route Groups         | Organizacion logica        | (auth) / (dashboard) / (public) | Estructura sin impacto en URL                             | Sin impacto en bundle      |
| Parallel Routes      | Multi-panel dashboard      | Next.js @dashboard / @sidebar   | Independencia de panels                                   | Parallel data fetching     |

## 34.2 Catalogo de Middleware Chains

| Middleware       | Capa   | Ejecucion        | Error Handling              | Configurable          | Logging              | Caching                |
| ---------------- | ------ | ---------------- | --------------------------- | --------------------- | -------------------- | ---------------------- |
| i18n.locale      | Edge   | Pre-render       | Fallback a default locale   | Si (config)           | Access log           | Stale-while-revalidate |
| auth.session     | Edge   | Pre-request      | Redirect a /login           | Si (public routes)    | Auth event log       | Session cache 5min     |
| rbac.authorize   | Edge   | Post-auth        | 403 Forbidden page          | Si (role-per-route)   | Access denied log    | Permission cache 10min |
| rate.limit       | Edge   | Pre-request      | 429 Too Many Requests       | Si (limite por ruta)  | Rate log             | Sliding window Redis   |
| csrf.protect     | Edge   | Post-auth (POST) | 403 CSRF failed             | Si (exclude routes)   | Security event log   | Token cache 1h         |
| cors.headers     | Edge   | Pre-response     | Options preflight           | Si (origin list)      | CORS log             | N/A                    |
| compression.gzip | Edge   | Post-response    | Passthrough                 | Si (level, types)     | N/A                  | N/A                    |
| security.headers | Edge   | Post-response    | Headers por defecto         | Si (HSTS, CSP)        | Security headers log | N/A                    |
| request.id       | Edge   | Pre-request      | Auto-generate UUID          | No                    | Trace propagation    | N/A                    |
| logging.request  | Edge   | Post-request     | Log respuesta completa      | Si (level, output)    | Full request log     | N/A                    |
| validation.input | Server | Pre-controller   | 400 Bad Request             | Si (schema por ruta)  | Validation error log | N/A                    |
| audit.trail      | Server | Post-response    | Async queue (fire & forget) | Si (sensitive routes) | Audit database       | N/A                    |

## 34.3 Politicas de Seguridad por Ruta

| Politica                | Configuracion                                   | Aplica A                     | Rutas Excluidas         | Monitoreo            | Enforcement                 |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ----------------------- | -------------------- | --------------------------- |
| CORS Origin Whitelist   | https://app.com, https://admin.app.com          | Todas las rutas browser      | /health, /metrics       | CORS error log       | API Gateway middleware      |
| Content Security Policy | default-src self; script-src self unsafe-inline | Todas las paginas            | N/A                     | CSP violation report | Helmet.js middleware        |
| X-Frame-Options         | DENY                                            | Todas las rutas              | N/A                     | N/A                  | Security headers middleware |
| X-Content-Type-Options  | nosniff                                         | Todas las respuestas         | N/A                     | N/A                  | Security headers middleware |
| Referrer-Policy         | strict-origin-when-cross-origin                 | Todas las paginas            | N/A                     | N/A                  | Helmet.js middleware        |
| Permissions-Policy      | camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()        | Todas las paginas            | N/A                     | N/A                  | Helmet.js middleware        |
| Rate Limiting (global)  | 1000 req/min por IP                             | Todas las rutas              | /health                 | Rate limit counter   | Rate limiter middleware     |
| Rate Limiting (auth)    | 100 req/min por token                           | Rutas autenticadas           | N/A                     | Rate limit counter   | Rate limiter middleware     |
| Rate Limiting (search)  | 30 req/min por token                            | Endpoints de busqueda        | N/A                     | Rate limit counter   | Rate limiter middleware     |
| Rate Limiting (export)  | 5 req/min por token                             | Endpoints de exportacion     | N/A                     | Rate limit counter   | Rate limiter middleware     |
| IP Allowlist (admin)    | Solo IPs corporativas                           | /api/v1/admin/*              | N/A                     | IP violation log     | IP filter middleware        |
| Request Size Limit      | 10MB default, 50MB uploads                      | POST/PUT                     | /api/v1/*/import (25MB) | Size violation log   | Body parser limit           |
| Bot Protection          | reCAPTCHA v3 score > 0.7                        | Rutas publicas               | /api/v1/internal/*      | Bot detection log    | reCAPTCHA middleware        |
| HSTS                    | max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains             | Todas las respuestas HTTPS   | N/A                     | N/A                  | Security headers middleware |
| JWT Expiry              | 15 minutos acceso, 7 dias refresh               | Todas las rutas autenticadas | N/A                     | Expiry event log     | Auth middleware             |

# 35. Gestion de Estado de la Aplicacion

Esta seccion describe en detalle la arquitectura de gestion de estado del sistema **SW-AOE**, incluyendo la clasificacion de tipos de estado, las estrategias de sincronizacion, los patrones de actualizacion y las consideraciones de rendimiento y escalabilidad.

## 35.1 Taxonomia de Tipos de Estado

| Tipo de Estado        | Alcance    | Duracion               | Fuente de Verdad | Ejemplo                        | Estrategia de Persistencia | Invalidacion           |
| --------------------- | ---------- | ---------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| Server State          | Global     | Sesion                 | Base de datos    | Entidades del dominio          | API + SWR / React Query    | Stale-while-revalidate |
| Client State (UI)     | Componente | Montaje                | Componente React | Form inputs, modales abiertos  | useState / useReducer      | Unmount cleanup        |
| Client State (Global) | Global     | Navegacion             | Store (Zustand)  | Sidebar abierto, tema visual   | Zustand store              | Navigation cleanup     |
| URL State             | Global     | Compartible            | URL params       | Filtros, paginacion, sort      | URLSearchParams            | Navegacion browser     |
| Session State         | Global     | Sesion                 | Session storage  | Carrito temporal, preferencias | SessionStorage API         | Tab close / logout     |
| Cache State           | Global     | Configurable TTL       | Cache server     | Datos frecuentes precomputados | Redis / In-memory          | TTL + event-based      |
| Form State            | Local      | Interaccion            | Formulario       | Draft de formulario            | React Hook Form            | Submit / reset         |
| Optimistic State      | Local      | Pendiente confirmacion | Cliente          | Edicion instantanea            | useOptimistic + SWR        | Rollback on error      |
| Auth State            | Global     | Sesion + refresh       | Auth server      | JWT token, user profile        | Cookie + memory            | Token expiry / logout  |
| Feature Flag State    | Global     | Sesion                 | Remote config    | Flags activos por usuario      | LaunchDarkly SDK           | Streaming update       |

## 35.2 Estrategias de Sincronizacion de Estado

| Estrategia         | Tipo de Estado     | Trigger                | Latencia         | Consistencia | Complejidad | Caso de Uso                          |
| ------------------ | ------------------ | ---------------------- | ---------------- | ------------ | ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Polling (SWR)      | Server State       | Intervalo configurable | Variable (1-60s) | Eventual     | Baja        | Dashboard con datos que cambian poco |
| Push (WebSocket)   | Real-time State    | Evento del servidor    | < 100ms          | Inmediata    | Media       | Notificaciones, colaboracion         |
| On-demand (mutate) | Server State       | Accion del usuario     | < 500ms          | Inmediata    | Baja        | Form submit, refresh manual          |
| Event bus          | Cross-module State | Evento de dominio      | < 1s             | Eventual     | Media       | Cache invalidation cross-modulo      |
| URL sync           | URL State          | Navegacion             | < 50ms           | Inmediata    | Baja        | Filtros, paginacion compartibles     |
| Redux saga         | Workflow State     | Accion async           | Variable         | Eventual     | Alta        | Workflows multi-paso complejos       |
| Optimistic update  | Form State         | Accion del usuario     | Inmediato        | Optimistic   | Media       | Edicion en tiempo real               |
| Snapshot           | Undo/Redo State    | Cada accion            | < 10ms           | Inmediata    | Media       | Editor con historial de cambios      |

## 35.3 Politicas de Caching por Tipo de Estado

| Tipo de Estado         | Cache Layer     | TTL Default | Stale Time | Revalidate       | Max Entries | Eviction Policy | Storage         |
| ---------------------- | --------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ---------------- | ----------- | --------------- | --------------- |
| Server State (lista)   | SWR Cache       | 60s         | 30s        | on-focus         | 100         | LRU             | Memory          |
| Server State (detalle) | SWR Cache       | 300s        | 60s        | on-focus         | 500         | LRU             | Memory          |
| Server State (lookup)  | SWR Cache       | 3600s       | 600s       | on-focus         | 50          | LRU             | Memory          |
| Auth Token             | Cookie + Memory | 15min       | 14min      | on-expiry        | 1           | TTL-based       | HttpOnly Cookie |
| User Preferences       | LocalStorage    | Infinity    | N/A        | on-change        | 1           | Manual clear    | LocalStorage    |
| Feature Flags          | LD Cache        | 5min        | 0s         | streaming        | 200         | LRU             | Memory          |
| Static Config          | Build-time      | Infinity    | N/A        | on-deploy        | All         | None            | Bundle          |
| i18n Messages          | SWR Cache       | Infinity    | 0s         | on-locale-change | 10          | LRU             | Memory          |
| File Upload Progress   | Component State | Session     | N/A        | N/A              | 1           | Unmount         | Memory          |
| Form Draft             | SessionStorage  | 24h         | N/A        | on-submit        | 10          | TTL-based       | SessionStorage  |

# 36. Arquitectura de Documentacion de APIs

Esta seccion define la estrategia de documentacion de APIs del sistema **SW-AOE**, incluyendo las especificaciones OpenAPI/Swagger, la generacion automatica de SDKs, las politicas de versionado de documentacion y los flujos de revision y aprobacion.

## 36.1 Estandares de Documentacion OpenAPI

| Estandar               | Version       | Uso                    | Herramienta     | Validacion        | Generacion                        | Hosting              |
| ---------------------- | ------------- | ---------------------- | --------------- | ----------------- | --------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| OpenAPI Specification  | 3.1.0         | API REST publica       | Swagger Editor  | spectral lint     | Clientes TypeScript, Python, Java | Redocly / Swagger UI |
| AsyncAPI Specification | 2.6.0         | Eventos Kafka          | AsyncAPI Studio | spectral lint     | Schema registry Avro              | AsyncAPI Studio      |
| gRPC Proto             | proto3        | Comunicacion interna   | protoc compiler | buf lint          | gRPC clients/stubs                | Buf Schema Registry  |
| JSON Schema            | Draft 2020-12 | Validacion de payloads | ajv / zod-gen   | ajv compile       | Zod schemas TypeScript            | N/A (bundled)        |
| Postman Collection     | v2.1          | Testing manual         | Postman         | Postman validator | N/A                               | Postman Workspace    |

## 36.2 Politicas de Versionado de Documentacion

| Aspecto                | Politica                     | Implementacion                       | Ejemplo                      |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------- |
| Version de spec        | Paralela a version de API    | /api/v1/ -> openapi-v1.yaml          | v1, v2 coexisten             |
| Changelog              | Generado automaticamente     | GitHub releases + API diff           | Breaking changes highlighted |
| Deprecation notice     | Tag en endpoint              | deprecated: true en OpenAPI          | 30 dias antes de removal     |
| Sunset header          | Header HTTP en respuestas    | Sunset: Sat, 1 Mar 2026 00:00:00 GMT | Fecha de desactivacion       |
| Migration guide        | Documento adjunto            | MDX con ejemplos antes/despues       | v1 -> v2 migration steps     |
| SDK version            | Sincronizada con API version | npm @project/sdk@1.x                 | SemVer strict                |
| Breaking change policy | Mayor version only           | Change log + migration guide         | v1.x -> v2.0                 |

## 36.3 Estructura del Documento OpenAPI por Modulo

| Seccion OpenAPI            | Contenido                              | Ejemplo                      | Auto-generado | Reviewed By |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| info                       | Titulo, descripcion, version, contacto | Modulo de Usuarios v1.0      | Parcial       | Tech Writer |
| servers                    | URLs por ambiente                      | dev, staging, prod           | Si            | DevOps      |
| paths                      | Todos los endpoints con operaciones    | /users, /users/:id           | Si            | Backend Dev |
| components/schemas         | DTOs de request/response               | UserDTO, CreateUserDTO       | Si            | Backend Dev |
| components/securitySchemes | Esquemas de autenticacion              | bearerAuth, apiKey           | Parcial       | Security    |
| components/responses       | Respuestas reutilizables               | 400Error, 401Error, 404Error | Parcial       | Tech Writer |
| components/parameters      | Parametros reutilizables               | pageParam, limitParam        | Si            | Backend Dev |
| tags                       | Agrupacion logica de endpoints         | CRUD, Search, Export         | No            | Tech Writer |
| externalDocs               | Links a documentacion adicional        | Confluence, Runbooks         | No            | Tech Writer |
| webhooks                   | Eventos de salida                      | user.created, user.updated   | Parcial       | Backend Dev |

## 36.4 Flujos de Revision y Aprobacion de Documentacion

| Etapa                       | Responsable        | Duracion   | Criterios de Aprobacion                                    | Herramienta            | Escalation |
| --------------------------- | ------------------ | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- | ---------- |
| Draft inicial               | Backend Developer  | 1-2 dias   | Spec completa, todos los endpoints documentados            | Swagger Editor         | Tech Lead  |
| Revision tecnica            | Tech Lead          | 1 dia      | Endpoints correctos, schemas validos, ejemplos funcionales | GitHub PR review       | Architect  |
| Revision de seguridad       | Security Team      | 1 dia      | Sin sensitive data expuesta, auth bien documentado         | Spectral lint + manual | CISO       |
| Revision de UX/docs         | Tech Writer        | 1 dia      | Descripciones claras, ejemplos comprensibles               | Redoc preview          | PM         |
| Aprobacion final            | Architecture Board | 1 dia      | Todos los criterios anteriores cumplidos                   | GitHub approval        | CTO        |
| Publicacion                 | DevOps             | 1 hora     | Desplegado en Swagger UI / Redocly                         | CI/CD pipeline         | On-call    |
| Notificacion a consumidores | API Team           | Automatico | Changelog generado y comunicado                            | Release notes          | Product    |

# 37. Matriz de Dependencias de Servicios

Esta seccion define la matriz completa de dependencias entre servicios del sistema **SW-AOE**, incluyendo dependencias internas entre modulos, dependencias de infraestructura, dependencias de servicios externos y el analisis de impacto de fallas.

## 37.1 Clasificacion de Tipos de Dependencia

| Tipo            | Descripcion                                       | Ejemplo                 | Impacto si Falla              | Mitigacion                   | Monitoreo                  |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Strong (Hard)   | El modulo no funciona sin esta dependencia        | Base de datos principal | Critico: modulo caido         | Replica, failover automatico | Health check cada 10s      |
| Soft (Optional) | El modulo funciona degradado sin esta dependencia | Servicio de email       | Degradado: sin notificaciones | Queue + retry asincrono      | Alerta si > 5min caido     |
| Eventual        | La consistencia se alcanza eventualmente          | Cache distribuido       | Bajo: mas lento               | Fallback local cache         | Latencia metric            |
| Async           | Comunicacion no bloqueante                        | Cola de jobs            | Medio: jobs se acumulan       | DLQ + alerta por volumen     | Queue depth metric         |
| Infrastructure  | Dependencia de plataforma                         | Kubernetes cluster      | Critico: todo caido           | Multi-region, multi-cloud    | Infrastructure health dash |

## 37.2 Dependencias de Infraestructura Compartida

| Servicio           | Tipo           | Version | SLA    | RTO    | RPO                | Multi-Region   | Backup Strategy          | Escalation       |
| ------------------ | -------------- | ------- | ------ | ------ | ------------------ | -------------- | ------------------------ | ---------------- |
| PostgreSQL Primary | Database       | 15.x    | 99.99% | 5 min  | 0 (sync replica)   | Active-active  | Continuous WAL archiving | DBA On-call      |
| PostgreSQL Replica | Database       | 15.x    | 99.9%  | 10 min | 5s lag max         | Active-passive | Streaming replication    | DBA On-call      |
| Redis Cluster      | Cache          | 7.x     | 99.99% | 2 min  | TTL-based          | Active-active  | RDB + AOF                | DevOps On-call   |
| Kafka Cluster      | Message Broker | 3.5+    | 99.99% | 5 min  | 0 (replication 3x) | Multi-AZ       | Topic retention + mirror | SRE On-call      |
| Elasticsearch      | Search Engine  | 8.x     | 99.9%  | 10 min | 5s lag             | Active-active  | Snapshot + replica       | DevOps On-call   |
| Kubernetes         | Orchestration  | 1.29+   | 99.99% | 5 min  | N/A                | Multi-AZ       | ETCD snapshots           | Platform On-call |
| MinIO / S3         | Object Storage | N/A     | 99.99% | 15 min | 0 (cross-region)   | Multi-region   | Versioning + lifecycle   | DevOps On-call   |
| Vault              | Secrets        | 1.15+   | 99.99% | 5 min  | Auto-unseal backup | HA cluster     | Raft storage             | Security On-call |
| Prometheus         | Monitoring     | 2.50+   | 99.9%  | 30 min | 1min data loss     | Single region  | Thanos long-term         | DevOps On-call   |
| Grafana            | Dashboards     | 10.x    | 99.9%  | 30 min | Config as code     | Single region  | Git-managed configs      | DevOps On-call   |

## 37.3 Analisis de Impacto de Fallas en Cadena

| Servicio Caido     | Impacto Inmediato                | Modulos Afectados     | Degradacion | Tiempo a Deteccion | Tiempo a Recovery       | Workaround Disponible       |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------- | --------------------- | ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- | --------------------------- |
| PostgreSQL Primary | Escritura bloqueada              | Todos los modulos     | Critico     | < 30s              | 5 min (failover)        | Read-only temporal          |
| PostgreSQL Replica | Reads en primary (mas lento)     | Todos los modulos     | Bajo        | < 60s              | 15 min (new replica)    | Primary reads               |
| Redis Cluster      | Sin cache, latencia incrementada | Todos los modulos     | Medio       | < 10s              | 2 min (restart)         | In-memory LRU local         |
| Kafka Cluster      | Eventos no se procesan           | Modulos con async ops | Alto        | < 30s              | 5 min (restart)         | DB outbox temporal          |
| Elasticsearch      | Busqueda fallback a DB           | Modulos con busqueda  | Medio       | < 10s              | 10 min (restart)        | DB LIKE queries             |
| Vault              | Secrets no accesibles            | Todos los modulos     | Critico     | < 30s              | 5 min (HA failover)     | Cached secrets (temporal)   |
| API Gateway        | No acceso publico                | Todos los modulos     | Critico     | < 10s              | 2 min (rolling restart) | Direct pod access (interna) |

## 37.4 Matriz de Acoplamiento entre Modulos

La siguiente tabla presenta el nivel de acoplamiento entre cada par de modulos, medido en una escala de 0 (ninguno) a 5 (muy alto), junto con el tipo de dependencia predominante:

| Modulo Origen        | Modulo Destino   | Acoplamiento (0-5) | Tipo de Dependencia | Patron de Comunicacion | Impacto si Destino Falla  | Estrategia de Desacoplamiento |
| -------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------ | ------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Autenticacion        | Todos            | 5                  | Strong (Hard)       | JWT tokens via headers | Critico: nadie autentica  | No aplicable (modulo central) |
| Autorizacion         | Todos            | 4                  | Strong (Hard)       | RBAC policies via API  | Critico: sin permisos     | Cache local de permisos       |
| Auditoria            | Todos            | 2                  | Soft (Optional)     | Kafka async events     | Bajo: logs no disponibles | Queue local + retry           |
| Notificaciones       | Todos            | 1                  | Eventual            | WebSocket + Kafka      | Bajo: sin push            | Polling fallback              |
| Gestion de Proyectos | Todos (contexto) | 3                  | Soft (Optional)     | Context via headers    | Medio: sin contexto       | Context cache local           |
| Busqueda             | Todos            | 2                  | Soft (Optional)     | Elasticsearch query    | Medio: busqueda lenta     | DB LIKE fallback              |
| Almacenamiento       | Todos            | 2                  | Soft (Optional)     | S3/GCS presigned URLs  | Bajo: sin archivos        | Local temp storage            |
